Inspiration and skill levels can still be inherited, so your challenge progress will not be affected by level and equipment resets.[/p][p]

[/p][p]𝐐𝟔: 𝐈𝐟 𝐈 𝐝𝐨 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐥𝐨𝐠 𝐢𝐧 𝐝𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐢𝐫𝐞 𝐒𝟐 𝐬𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐨𝐧 𝐚𝐟𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐒𝟏 𝐞𝐧𝐝𝐬, 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐝𝐚𝐲𝐬 𝐨𝐧 𝐦𝐲 𝐌𝐨𝐧𝐭𝐡𝐥𝐲 𝐏𝐚𝐬𝐬 𝐬𝐭𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐛𝐞 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐬𝐮𝐦𝐞𝐝?[/p][p]𝐀𝟔: You will be compensated with one extra day when crossing to a new season. After the new season starts, the remaining Monthly Pass time will continue to be consumed whether you log in or not, and unclaimed rewards due to not logging in will not be refunded.[/p][p]

[/p][p]𝐐𝟖: 𝐈𝐟 𝐚 𝐩𝐥𝐚𝐲𝐞𝐫 𝐢𝐬 𝐜𝐮𝐫𝐫𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐥𝐲 𝐨𝐧 𝐑𝐞𝐛𝐨𝐫𝐧 𝟑 𝐬𝐞𝐫𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐝𝐨𝐞𝐬 𝐧𝐨𝐭 𝐥𝐨𝐠 𝐢𝐧 𝐝𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐢𝐫𝐞 𝐒𝟐 𝐬𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐨𝐧, 𝐰𝐡𝐞𝐧 𝐥𝐨𝐠𝐠𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐢𝐧 𝐝𝐮𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐒𝟑 𝐬𝐞𝐚𝐬𝐨𝐧, 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐲 𝐛𝐞 𝐦𝐨𝐯𝐞𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝐚𝐧𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐯𝐞𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐚𝐧 𝐬𝐞𝐫𝐯𝐞𝐫 𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐨 𝐚 𝐧𝐞𝐰 𝐬𝐞𝐫𝐯𝐞𝐫?[/p][p]𝐀𝟖: If the player’s current server Reborn 3 is in S1, after the season ends it will merge into S2-1. This is often caused by conflicts with previous installation files or connection timeouts.[/p][p]If this occurs, please try the following steps:[/p][p] 𝐏𝐂 𝐮𝐬𝐞𝐫𝐬:[/p][p] · Ensure your system is Windows 10 or higher (macOS is not supported).[/p][p] · Manually delete the game folder from your Steam directory, then reinstall.[/p][p] · If any files remain after uninstalling via Steam, delete them manually.[/p][p] 𝐀𝐧𝐝𝐫𝐨𝐢𝐝 𝐮𝐬𝐞𝐫𝐬:[/p][p] · Completely uninstall and reinstall the game.[/p][p] · No need to manually delete folders.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Note: After reinstalling, the game may display a temporary black screen on first launch. Please restart the app multiple times if needed. In rare cases, the issue may be caused by a timeout when accessing the following patch list server:[/p][p][/p][p] [url="https://down.dragongamena.com/Static/outer/patch_list"]https://down.dragongamena.com/Static/outer/patch_list[/url][/p][p][/p][p]If the issue persists, please provide the following for further support:[/p][p]1.Your device model and OS version[/p][p]2.Game log files from the following locations:[/p][p] · PC: Steam\\steamapps\\common\\Dragonheir Silent Gods\\logs[/p][p] · Android: Android/data/com.sgra.dragon/files[/p][p]
[/p][p]Please locate files ending in .log (e.g., dragon_log_20250714.log). Compress and send them to our support team.[/p][p]Thank you for your patience and continued support. We look forward to welcoming you back after the update.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/d9030bb8e9ffa01e5626f932826674b938099406.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 🎯 New Hero Breakdown: Skills & Strategy – Sintrellia
notes.content:
[p]She’s Dragonsaerie’s master of duplication — a summoner who copies your strongest allies and overwhelms enemies with sheer numbers. If you're building a summoner comp, Sintrellia is your new MVP.[/p][p]
[/p][p] 💡 𝐊𝐞𝐲 𝐇𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐥𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭𝐬:[/p][p] 🔹Her Ultimate copies your highest ATK summoned unit and buffs its damage[/p][p] 🔹Best paired with Black Dragon Lelwanis or Ladehlia for high-damage summons[/p][p] 🔹Combine with Irzillas to stack buffs and auto-resummon fallen units[/p][p] 🔹Focus on pure ATK gear — Scarlet Hunt, Cyril's set, and Dawn Pipe Organ are top picks[/p][p]

[p]She once walked beneath the canopy of Nytheria’s radiant Blue Oak, a gentle healer with flowers in her hair and a warmth that comforted all who came to her. Felosia was the heart of her wood elf tribe—tending not just to wounds, but to sorrows. Even after exile pushed her kin to the archipelago’s shores, she remained their steadfast light. But not all losses can be mended, and not all friendships survive catastrophe.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Now reimagined for the reboot season, Felosia emerges with a refined design that reflects the duality of who she’s become: calm and distant, yet deeply empathetic. Her pale-toned look echoes the cool sorrow of her journey, while floral accents and soft features keep her rooted in the gentle grace she’s known for.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Her practical new attire—woven leggings, travel-ready details—speaks to the responsibilities she’s taken on in her people's new life. Between treating the wounded and negotiating peace with the radiant Glimmersprites, Felosia carries more than memory—she carries the hopes of an entire people.[/p][p]
[/p][p]And through it all, one thing remains: the Sacred Blue Oak orb at her side. With it, she summons frostbound shields to protect those she can still reach… even as she mourns the ones she couldn’t.[/p][p]

notes.content: [p][/p][p]The rift swallows you whole.[/p][p]A blur of wind, bone, and broken time surges past until you awaken beneath a lifeless sky. The air stinks of rot and old magic. notes.title: To the American Travelers of Adenthia: We're Back, Stronger Than Ever!
notes.content: [p]Dear Travelers,[/p][p]Since Dragonheir temporarily departed from the US region due to adjustments in our operations, your perseverance and patience have been our greatest motivation for continuous improvement. Whether it's the ever-active discussion threads on our Discord server or the "when will you return" comments on our Facebook page—we know that even within those holding silent vigil lies a deep attachment to the continent of Adenthia. [b]Thank you for never leaving, ensuring that there remains a chapter in the stories of this fantastical continent which will be filled by the legendary exploits of American players.[/b][/p][p]Today, with gratitude and determination, we officially announce: After a lengthy duration of comprehensive optimization and preparation, [b]Dragonheir will restart its US servers with global version synchronization, and all adventurers will be able to continue their journey.[/b][/p][p]This return features core adjustments based on player feedback, with exclusive benefits for returning players. We sincerely invite you to return to the continent of Adenthia.[/p][h2][b]I. Core Experience Optimizations[/b][/h2][h3][b]Summoning Costs Reduced by 71%[/b][/h3][p]Single summon price reduced from $5 to [b]$1.43[/b], with new targeted card pools and transparent pity mechanisms for improved target hero acquisition efficiency.[/p][h3][b]Zero-grind Progression System[/b][/h3][p]Individual hero levels eliminated. Now, all characters share level progression for immediate usability, instead shifting the focus to strategic team composition.[/p][h3][b]Seasonal Gameplay Updates[/b][/h3][p]Launch featuring three major modes: Guild Boss Battles, Roguelike Dungeons, and Ranked Arena, with weekly activity content updates[/p][h2][b]II. Exclusive Benefits for Returning Players[/b][/h2][h3][b]Complete Account Data Inheritance[/b][/h3][p]Due to significant adjustments to hero abilities and seasonal gameplay, after the new version update, all players will need to begin with the brand new Season 1, but most regional players will retain 100% of their heroes, Artifacts, Dragon Crystals, Wyrmarrow, Dice, Skill Scrolls, and other assets.[/p][p]For users in the US region, due to data compliance requirements and technical architecture adjustments, your game accounts and historical data will be affected and cannot be inherited. However, we will do our best to protect your interests and gaming experience by providing past account appraisal activities.[/p][h3][b]Pre-summons Event[/b][/h3][p]To reward and help Travelers easily begin their adventure, we will be eliminating traditional gacha randomness and initial account acquisition troubles, and we will do so by launching a major [b]Pre-summon benefit event [/b]before server launch.[/p][p]During the event, each Traveler can enjoy up to 250 pre-draws, select and lock ten 10-pull results to generate your exclusive Prophecy Code. After server launch, import the Prophecy Code to directly secure your first 100 Heliolite Summons results, guaranteed to have three Legendary gold cards. Become a gacha god with ease! Press the event link now to participate in this epic benefit event![/p][h3][b]Past Account Appraisal Rewards[/b][/h3][p]We deeply understand that character data is an adventurer's most treasured asset. Despite facing complex technical environments, we promise: [b]we will never betray your trust.[/b][/p][p]To maximize the protection of US region players' interests, we have established the following compensation plan:[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]Through the Account Appraisal website, upload your past Dragonheir character names to view and confirm your gaming activity history and purchase records. We will appraise your account and assign a grade based on corresponding information, providing you with Dragon Crystal rewards matching your grade.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][list][*][p]After account appraisal, you can also invite friends to form a five-person team and unlock the dual team reward mechanism:[/p][list][*][p][b]Allied Team Appraisal Tier Rewards[/b][/p][list][*][p]Based on the total account appraisal value of team members, the entire team can receive the corresponding tier of Dragon Crystal rewards.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Returning Player Bonus[/b][/p][list][*][p]If the team includes returnees from Dragonheir, for each returning player on the team, the entire team receives an additional Random Legendary Equipment Chest x1.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]III.[b] Take Action Now![/b][/h2][h3][b]Pre-registration Site Reservation[/b][/h3][p]Visit [url="https://bit.ly/Preregisternowus"]https://bit.ly/Preregisternowus[/url]to complete pre-registration. Reaching pre-registration milestones will grant additional summon attempts upon server launch.[/p][h3][b]Pre-summons Event[/b][/h3][p]Event Entrance: [url="https://bit.ly/Pre-summonEventUS"]https://bit.ly/Pre-summonEventUS[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]This update will simultaneously optimize global server experiences, and the US region's return means the continent of Adenthia is finally complete.[/p][p]No matter where you come from, in this moment, we all stand on the same starting line—a new season, new legends, awaiting to be defined by Travelers![/p][p]Return immediately! You will not only rediscover the joy of adventure but also become a core participant in this journey of rebirth. We look forward to standing alongside you once again on this quest of dragon-slaying![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/3d88991f490d74ec3a49422c0357492076ca1a67.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 🔥 The Pre-summon Event is Here! ✨

notes.title: ✨ Meet Lossenia, the Lady of Stars
notes.content:
[p]Born under a meteor shower and blessed by starlight, [b]Lossenia[/b] has spent much of her life in quiet seclusion—shielded from harm, hidden from the world. The tides were her only witness, the sea breeze her closest friend. Forbidden to leave the borders of Increscent, she found freedom only in stories—tales of forbidden love and faraway lands she kept secret from even her brother, Thelendor. 

But starlight cannot be caged forever. Though gentle in spirit, Lossenia harbors a quiet longing—for wonder, for danger, for the world beyond the shore. She is still learning the ways of life, but her heart has already stepped beyond the threshold. Now, the Lady of Stars is ready to write her own story—one lived, not read. 

🌙 Lossenia returns with a [b]fairytale-inspired[/b] redesign. She now fully embraces the look of a starlit princess— with long [b]white hair[/b], clear [b]blue eyes[/b], and a soft, graceful style. Her updated outfit is simple and elegant, made of light silk with starlight details. 
This version highlights her gentle personality and dreamy, storybook charm. 
👉 Will you guide her story this time?

notes.content:
Seven months after it ended support in US territories, developer SGRA Studio confirms that its free-to-play fantasy RPG Dragonheir: Silent Gods is coming back to North America as part of a global "rebirth" that dramatically redesigns the game's combat, progression, and pricing model. While its player count reached more than ten million worldwide, its Steam rating has remained 'mixed,' and in September 2024 service in the United States was discontinued, leaving the game inaccessible on the Valve platform. Now, it's finally making a return.

notes.title: A Letter from the Developers
notes.content:
A Letter from the Developers
Dear Traveler,

Since its launch in September 2023, Dragonheir has received support and love from 10 million Travelers worldwide. Your perseverance and feedback give us the confidence and motivation to make this game the best it can be.
We deeply understand that many Travelers have been dissatisfied with Dragonheir's lack of new content since December. I'd like to take this opportunity to communicate with all Travelers about what has happened with Dragonheir over the past year and a half, and to talk about our plans moving forward.

I. Changes
From late 2023 to early 2024, while we were still basking in the joy of Dragonheir's successful launch, various unexpected changes began to occur both within and outside our team, causing the development of new content to stagnate for nearly a year. After numerous efforts, it wasn't until the end of 2024 that Dragonheir was finally able to reconnect with players in most regions around the world.

II. Issues and Adjustments
The migration was a significant loss for both the project team and the players, but it also gave us an opportunity to examine ourselves.
While migrating, we have also begun reflecting on and revising Dragonheir. We believe that for Dragonheir to perform better, we need to address the following issues:
1. Too Expensive: The $5 per summon price and the gacha design focused on a general pool with all heroes mixed together were too costly for most players. It was too expensive to obtain the heroes a player wanted, and even after four seasons, many players still couldn't assemble mainstream hero lineups to experience the joy of strategic gameplay.
2. High Learning Curve for Team Strategies: In-game, we lacked guidance for hero team composition, requiring players to invest enormous effort into researching hero skills, equipment, and team synergies. For players with fewer Legendary heroes, finding effective team strategies was even more difficult.
3. Lack of Diverse Gameplay: We introduced numerous challenge stages centered around team strategies. However, stages alone don't create a complete gaming experience. The game's modes still need adjustment and expansions.

Therefore, since October 2024, we have been working to adjust the game's content, hoping to welcome all players back with an improved experience. Our changes include:
• Significant Price Reductions: We hope that by lowering the cost of each summon, adding targeted banners, and setting more reasonable pity systems, most players will be able to assemble strategically viable teams.
• Streamlined Progression: We want players to spend less time leveling up individual heroes and more time focusing on the core gameplay to have fun: selecting suitable heroes and using effective strategies to overcome stronger opponents. As a result, we've completely abandoned individual hero levels. All heroes now share a level, making them as close to "ready to use upon summoning" as possible.
• Combat System Overhaul: With reduced prices and streamlined progression focusing players on team strategy enjoyment, we needed more accessible strategic gameplay that beginners could easily grasp and gradually master. To achieve this, we've replaced our previous Elemental Affinity-based team building guide with "comps," each with different effects. Through these strategies, we hope players will gradually understand each hero's abilities and discover unique approaches to tackle different bosses.
• Redesigned Season Gameplay: To address the "combat needs to be fun" issue, we focused on "having fun content." As a seasonal game, the purpose of seasons shouldn't just be a new round of competition. We want each season to focus players on different core gameplay elements, so we've planned various central mechanics, such as Alliance PvP and Alliance Boss modes, as well as solo roguelike gameplay. We hope to continuously bring players new experiences.
These features were first launched in the mainland China version and have proven effective. Now we finally have the confidence to synchronize these adjustments with the global version.

III. Rebirth: Global Version Challenges and Plans
The reason we launched in mainland China first was because it was a completely new region, allowing us to adjust the game to its optimal state without interference from existing online data. Now, as we return to the global version, any modifications directly affect tens of thousands of online players, so we must proceed with caution.

After careful consideration, we plan to restart Dragonheir's global version content updates and promotion strategy in the following ways:
1. Season Restart with Synchronized Content: We want all players to experience the proven content. Therefore, in the global version, we will restart seasons and updates, releasing new content according to the seasonal schedule and merging it with the global version. All players will start from Season 1, but user data will be retained: Due to significant adjustments to hero abilities and seasonal gameplay, after the new version update, all players will need to begin from the brand new Season 1.
2. All players will start from Season 1, but user data will be retained: Due to significant adjustments to hero abilities and seasonal gameplay, after the new version update, all players will need to begin from the brand new Season 1. However, players will retain their heroes, Artifacts, Dragon Crystals, Wyrmarrows, dice, and Skill Scrolls. Your assets will not be lost, so please don't worry.
3. Account valuation for veteran players with exclusive benefits: In addition to retaining all user data, before the official restart, we will launch an account valuation event for veteran players, returning your previous investments in the form of special rewards in the new version. Through this approach, we hope to express our sincere gratitude to the Travelers who have continuously supported us by providing attractive rewards, and we encourage you to spread the word, to reunite with your former battle mates to once again venture across the continent of Adenthia. (Please follow upcoming community content for detailed rules)
4. Complete global launch: When the new version goes live, Dragonheir will also relaunch in North America and several other affected regions. We are delighted to once again provide complete service to Travelers across all global regions.

Detailed update plans and event information will be gradually released through Discord and Facebook communities in the future. Travelers, please stay tuned.
For all players who have persevered and accompanied Dragonheir until today, our hearts are filled with gratitude. We also solemnly promise to continue delivering quality updates for the global version, bringing Travelers more and better gameplay experiences.
To express our gratitude, we're offering a gift code containing 5 Heliolite Dice, 10 Starlight Stone Dice, and 1,000,000 Gold, which you can redeem by entering the game now:【BRANDNEWDH】(Valid from April 28 to May 31.)

We hope you continue to follow Dragonheir and the community before the season restart. We also welcome your feedback in the community. Together, let us witness the rebirth of a better Dragonheir.

notes.title: Regarding Settlements During Server Maintenance
notes.content:
Dear Traveler,

Thank you so much for your continued love and support for Dragonheir: Silent Gods.
The game will enter maintenance starting from UTC 2024/11/7 02:00. We expect to complete the update and reopen the servers in early December after the update is finished (please stay tuned for official announcements and notifications for the exact time). 

During this maintenance period, please note the following regarding game progress, time-limited events, and monthly passes:
Monthly Passes (Wyrmarrow Mining Warrant & Daily Supply from Three Ears): The validity period will be extended by the number of days affected during the maintenance;
Example: If you have 10 days left on your monthly pass on November 7th, you will still have 10 days remaining when the servers reopen.
Walker's Trails: Upon server reopening, you will receive compensation for the Trail experience and rewards based on completing all daily tasks and weekly quests during the maintenance period. For expired Trails, rewards will be based on the maximum obtainable experience within the valid period;
Example: If your Journey level is 20 with Travel EXP at (0/100) on November 7th, and the maintenance lasts for 25 days, you will receive 6700 Travel EXP (100 max daily EXP * 25 days plus 150 EXP from 28 weekly quests over 4 weeks), equivalent to Trail level 67.
Additionally, to thank you for your patience during this extended wait, we will provide all Travelers with: Heliolite Dice × 25 and Wyrmarrow ×1,888 as compensation upon server reopening.

Regarding Seasons:
1. Time-limited series events within the season (Treasure Hunter, Goblin Rage, Cave Raider, Ace Challenger, Hard Training, Imperial Shadow Recast, Lunar Halo Convergence, Awakening the Spring of Iskalland, Dance of Misfortune) will not be restarted and will end as originally scheduled.
(Example) If Server A's limited-time event started on Nov 6 with a 15-day duration, and the server maintenance began on Nov 7 (1 day into the event), the event originally set to end on Nov 21 will conclude normally without reopening. No compensation will be provided for event-related rewards. For instance, the Dance of Misfortune event and its exchange shop will not reopen, and all displayed exchange rewards will become unavailable and expire when the event ends;

2. Season-limited summon series (Echoes of Otherworld, Heliolite Aggregation,Celestial Alternate Summons, Blessed Summons) will not be reopened and will end as originally scheduled.

3. Seasonal Settlement:
(Example) If Server A enters maintenance on the 10th day of a new season before the Season Boss opens, and the maintenance period ends before the Season Boss becomes available, the Season Boss challenge will proceed normally upon server reopening, and season rankings will be settled as usual;
(Example) If Server B enters maintenance on the 70th day of a new season with the season boss about to open, but the server reopens after the boss challenge period ends, the season rankings will be settled based on data from before the maintenance;
(Example) If Server C enters maintenance on the 80th day of a new season during an ongoing season boss challenge, and the server reopens after the boss challenge period, the season rankings will be settled based on the last available boss challenge data before maintenance. 

Dragonheir: Silent Gods Project Team
Nov 6, 2024

notes.title: The Intermediate Season
notes.content:
Greetings, Travelers:
We are grateful for your continuous support for Dragonheir: Silent Gods, and we are here to announce:
An Intermediate Season will be around the corner. During the Intermediate Season, your exploration in Adenthia will remain the same as that of S4. 
Due to multiple causes, such as data migration, the development team has to wait until the transitions are completed before we can restart the game development and create new content wholeheartedly for Travelers.

〓 Brief Introduction to Intermediate Season Content 〓
■ Exploration Replay
● [San Ramallan]: The sandbox scene for [Otherworld Exploration] of S4 returns. San Ramallan, situated in Southern Adenthia, adjacent to the vast Ysurman Desert, is said to imprison a "malfeasant" undergoing the Dragon Queen's retribution.
■ Story Replay
● [Phantom of San Ramallan]: The story for [Otherworld Exploration] of S4 returns. As the whole Material Plane sinks into the turmoil of inquietum, Isitarian speculates that this chaos may derive from San Ramallan and summons you for help. You will be traveling to the volcano alone, and looking into the connection between the incident and Aschetius, the Fiery Dragon.
■ Hero Return
● Legendary Artifacts, Legendary Heroes, Legendary Hero Imprints and Epic Heroes from the previous seasons will be available in the exchange shops of Fey Meander, Pillar of Trial, fragment events, and season settlement. Travelers may take this opportunity to obtain past content.
■ Dungeon Reward
● The reward pool of each equipment dungeon will be expanded by 1 or 2 sets of legendary equipment based on the S4 reward pool.
■ Boss Return
● [Lady of Nightswamp - Phosphora]: The Fey Meander Boss of this season, a banshee reigning the domain of darkness. Her passive skill summons two cocoons to aid in the battle and grants herself Defense Up and shield each time Phosphora loses a fixed portion of her Max HP. Her ultimate skill deals global damage and can inflict Silence and Blind on her enemies.
● [Lava Fiery Dragon - Aschetius]: The Otherworld Exploration Boss of this season, an evil dragon god corrupted by the inquietum. His passive skill increases his damage dealt over time in the battle, and grants himself certain stacks of Frenzy effect each time he casts a skill. When his Frenzy stacks reach a specific number, he will deal global damage to his enemies at intervals.
■ Introduction to Event Settlement
● [Forthfaring Summons]: Special summons customized on the basis of Travelers' S4 season settlement rankings. There will be three of these exclusive summons, each requiring [Season Summon Tickets] of the corresponding rarity, while all of them provide an easily available guarantee and a high rate of pulling heroes from the new season.
● [Odyssey Featured Summons]: During the Intermediate Season, season-exclusive summons for S4, S3, and S2 will return according to this schedule:
Day 1-10 of the season: S4 exclusive summons
Day 29-38 of the season: S3 exclusive summons
Day 57-66 of the season: S2 exclusive summons
● Intermediate Season settlement reward: season-exclusive Avatar Frame and Avatar will be replaced by Heliolite Dice in the Mount&Season Shop, while other merchandise will remain the same.
■ Other Content
● [Temporal Vortex - Raging Mode]: This challenge mode will be available periodically with certain unlock conditions and a time limit. In the Raging Mode, Travelers can obtain one [Fixed Buff] and select two of multiple [Optional Buffs] to initiate the challenge without challenge attempt limits. Depending on the damage record, damage milestone rewards and ranking rewards will be issued.
● [Elemental Affinity] Rotation: The Intermediate Season will inherit the S4 Elemental Affinity (Fire & Poison - Ulceration, Lightning & Radiance - Resplendence, Ice & Necrosis - Permafrost), and there will be some adjustments to the Elemental Affinity skills (i.e. Affinity Solvent upgrades).
● [Clepsydra Trail]: Will inherit the [World Challenge] and [Champion Emblem] missions added in S4.
● [Journal - Adventure]: Will inherit the trial missions added in S4.
● [Battle - Acceleration]: In-battle acceleration feature will be available for battles of Local Quest, Temporal Vortex, Overworld Boss, Season Boss, etc.
● Optimized UI interactions and display.
● Other adjustments and optimizations for higher accessibility.

notes.title: Change of Publishing Entity & Account Data Migration
notes.content:
Dear Travelers:
First, we would like to extend our sincerest gratitude to everyone for your continuous support and love for Dragonheir: Silent Gods. Your support has enabled us to achieve such gratifying progress and accomplishments.
Due to a recent change in the game's operating and publishing entity, we will need to adjust the game's operation plan accordingly. As of November 7, 2024, the game's operations will be transferred to Proxima Beta Pte. Limited, who will take over the publishing and operating responsibilities moving forward.
We understand that Dragonheir: Silent Gods holds precious memories of adventure for many Travelers. We are excited to continue working with you under the new publishing and operating entity, and we look forward to further developing the game and continuing our journey together.

Account Data Migration
Due to the aforementioned change, we will be conducting the Account Data Migration in the near future. Here is a brief introduction to the process:
① Migration Scope: The migration will apply to each user account that has been used to create in-game characters and did not opt out of transferring its data to the new publisher. 
② Migration Requirements: before the Migration Time starts, Travelers will need to (i) log in to the game; (ii) access the Account Binding feature by clicking the entrance located in the upper-right corner of the game's home page; (iii) complete the account binding process using a Google/Facebook/Apple ID account; (iv) after binding your account, please double-check the binding status to ensure it was successful; (v) make a note of your account ID, as you might need this later.
※ [Caution]: User Accounts that were only bound with VK accounts or Guest Accounts will need to be additionally bound to a Google/Facebook/Apple ID account before the Migration Time starts in order to complete the data migration process.
③ Migration Time: starting on November 7, 2024, at 02:00 UTC, until the game version update is completed and available in the relevant online stores. During this time, the game won’t be available.
④ Migration Preparation: To complete the data migration process, you will need your regularly used mobile or PC device for login, as well as your third-party account (Google, Facebook, or Apple ID) that is bound to your game account, along with its password
For Travelers who have completed the account binding before the migration time and have not opted out of transferring their data to the new publisher, your account data will be safely preserved during the migration. You will be able to explore the land of Adenthia again once the migration is complete.
Before we initiate the data migration process to the new publisher, we will provide a detailed tutorial and FAQ page to all Travelers. Please note that during the Migration Time, game login will be unavailable for 24 days (a detailed schedule will be released soon). Please stay tuned for further notice.

※ Reminder:
Please take good care of your game account data and personal information, and do not disclose your account information to others.
Server Maintenance Time: Starting on November 7, 2024, at 02:00 UTC. During this period, logging in to the game will not be available until the maintenance is completed. After the maintenance, Travelers will need to download and install the newest version of the game from the official website or online stores to access the game again.
Migration Gift: After the server maintenance and migration are completed, Travelers can log in to the new version of the game to receive [Heliolite Dice x5 & Starlight Stone Dice x10] as a gift.
Migration Completion Time: Silent Gods is scheduled to be back online on December 1, 2024, at 02:00 UTC, after the server maintenance. Please be aware that such a schedule is subject to change, so please stay tuned for specific timing updates in future notices. After the game is back online, Travelers can log in to the new version of the game using the Google, Facebook, or Apple ID account bound to their game account.
Once Travelers complete the migration process according to the Migration Requirements, all your game assets (including game progress, currencies, resources, items, etc.) will be preserved. You may log in using your bound Google, Facebook, or Apple ID account to verify the integrity of your data and progress.

After the completion of data migration and server maintenance, some Travelers may need to undergo age verification again before accessing the game or making in-game purchases, in accordance with relevant laws and regulations in certain regions. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding.
Our goal is to ensure that player account data remains consistent and intact throughout the change of operating and publishing entity, without affecting your gaming experience. We are fully committed to serving all Travelers:

If you have any questions or issues related to game content, features, feedback, or bug reports, please contact us via the official communities or the in-game customer service.
If you have any concerns or difficulties regarding account data migration and server maintenance, feel free to seek assistance from our customer service as well.

We are indebted for your continuous support for Dragonheir: Silent Gods, so we have prepared a gift for all our Travelers via the in-game mail (including Wyrmarrow x140, Scholar Scroll x5, Mini Stamina Bread x2). Please kindly collect the gift, and we look forward to embarking on new adventures together!

Dragonheir: Silent Gods Team

notes.title: Termination Service of Dragonheir: Silent Gods in US Region
notes.content:
Dear Travelers,
We are much indebted for your long term support for Dragonheir: Silent Gods! As announced on July 16,2024, the operation of Dragonheir: Silent Gods in the US region will be officially terminated On September 16,2024 at 4:00 a.m.(EST). Players in the US regions will be unable to access the game from said time on.

As creators of countless epic journeys, you have graced the multiverse of Dragonheir: Silent Gods with infinite luster and dynamic. Here and now, we extend our wholehearted gratitude toward your fond love and encouragement, and bid farewell to every single Traveller in the US region.

After the termination of services, relevant data and character information for players’ accounts in the US region
(including but not limited to characters, game items,and top-up information, etc.) will be archived. Should you hold any questions about your data and character information or require other information, please feel free to contact us at [dragonheir-support@nvsgames.com].

Lastly, we would like to express our appreciation for your company and the valuable time we spent together exploring Adenthia. We are eagerly looking forward to a reunion in the near future and the unforgettable memories we are to create once again!

notes.title: 🌋 Venture into the Riotous Volcano in Otherworld Exploration! 🔥
notes.content:
The Riotous Volcano chapter in Otherworld Exploration is now live! The material plane is falling into chaos, and San Ramallan is at the center of it all. Ishtarian has summoned you to uncover the truth behind this disturbance, believed to be linked to the Fiery Dragon Aschetius.
🐉 Pursuit of Dragon Overview
Three new gameplay modes: Adventure Preparation, Elemental Domain, and Chaos Shadows.
Earn Exploration Progress and contribute to Server-wide Progress.
Server-wide progress cap rewards all players with a 15% bonus to ATK, DEF, and HP in the Land of Flames.
Unlock the second phase by completing all three gameplay modes.
Oasis Water: Exclusive stamina item with a 150-point daily cap.
Total rewards: 60 Wyrmarrows, 160 Exploration Progress, 5000 Affinity Solvent, and 133,000 Gold.
[Adventure Preparation]: Pick up to 4 quests daily at the Adventure Preparation station.
[Elemental Domain]: The San Ramallan offers 3 Elemental Domain challenges, each with Difficulty 5.
· Bosses are immune to control and take 50% more damage from specific elements.
· All domains offer the same rewards with unlimited hero usage.
· Clear all stages for the best In-depth Exploration rewards.
· Prioritize toughest Elemental Domain at Difficulty 5 after maximizing Chaos Shadows rewards.
[Chaos Showdown]: Six bosses spawn in the Ramalan Volcano for challenge, offering different rewards based on the total damage dealt.
 · Same mechanics as the Dance of Misfortune Continental Challenge but unlimited attempts.
· Bosses take 100% more damage from a specific element.
· Each hero can only be used once per day in Chaos Shadows.
· Accuracy-focused heroes need over 280 Accuracy for debuffs and dispels.
· Match DMG heroes to the boss's weak element. Support and Defense heroes need elemental affinity.

🧭 Exploration Quests
Divided into Daily, In-depth, and Alliance Exploration.
Complete quests to increase exploration progress.

🗺️ Exploration Progress and Alliance Buffs
Earn Exploration Progress in different gameplays to claim rewards.
Receive Alliance Buffs based on Total Alliance Exploration Progress.

notes.title: Development Future Roadmap (Episode 1)
notes.content:
Dear Travelers,
Thank you all for supporting us along the journey in Dragonheir: Silent Gods. We are delighted to witness your adventures and have received numerous recognitions and suggestions.
One of the issues you are most concerned about has always been the future game content. This has been our primary focus. In the subsequent game versions, we will bring you new progression modes, gameplay content, and improvements to reduce the grind. We hope to share our update plans with you and hope you can take some time to read this article:

New Progression Modes
1. [Easier EXP Gains]
To reduce the time spent on less interesting grinding gameplay, we plan to introduce the Level Resonance feature, which will directly boost your entire team's level. Once this feature is activated, the Breakthrough system will also be adjusted accordingly, significantly speeding up your leveling experience and hero progression. After the first month of a new season, you will no longer need to grind EXP Dungeons.

2. [Richer Progression Experience]
We hope players can enjoy a more intuitive, positive gaming experience during the mid-to-late season progression:
We will introduce a Hero Talent system, providing heroes with multi-branch talent trees. By choosing different talent paths for your heroes, they can specialize in certain areas, bringing you more diverse battle strategies and deeper progression experiences. The corresponding Elemental Talent Dungeon will also be launched along with this system.
To make the roles of various heroes more distinct, we are also working on an Equipment Attribute Enhancement feature. This will offer you more freedom when you are configuring lineups.
Additionally, we plan to introduce an Attribute Transfer feature, allowing equipment attributes to be directly transferred to another piece of new equipment, aiming to reduce repetitive grinding content.

3. Progression Recycling
We noticed that many players experienced a progression gap due to resource resets during season transitions. To improve the cross-season progression experience, we will retain certain results that are hard to achieve in the current season through the Progression Recycling system.

New Gameplay Content
1. [Roguelike Gameplay]
To meet your need for deeper strategic gameplay, we plan to introduce tiered roguelike content. In this mode, you will gradually build your team through random events and enjoy the fun of overcoming stages with different team lineups.

2. [New Arena: The Emerald Court]
The Emerald Court emphasizes strategic fun with fair competition. In this mode, all players will choose from heroes, equipment, and artifacts with the same attributes. You will build your very own PvP team and enjoy deeper strategic experiences by adjusting skill release timings before battles.

A More Friendly Grinding Experience
1. [Auto Tower Climbing]
The Fey Meander and the Pillar of Trial are two major challenges in each season that require you to invest a lot of time to conquer. We plan to introduce an Auto Tower Climb feature to alleviate the fatigue from such a grinding experience.

2. [Other Optimizations]
Besides the above, we will also introduce features like Equip All for quick hero equipment setup, Auto Pathing, Camp Dispatch, Temporary Mounts, and other optimization features to reduce the grind. We will also optimize multiplayer real-time non-auto battle gameplay and adjust various stages and boss mechanics to bring you a more relaxed and fun gaming experience.

Spoiler
Apart from the Lamar Volcano sandbox, which is to be introduced during the Otherworld Exploration phase of Season 4, future storylines and sandboxes are also in the works. The currently available sandboxes, storylines, and NPC interactions will also be optimized to provide a more immersive experience.

Thank you for reading, Traveler. Stay tuned for more exciting content.

notes.title: ⚔️ The New Grand Gladiator Arena! ✨
notes.content:
The Grand Gladiator Arena game mode has undergone significant changes, including updates to its matchmaking system, ranking mechanics, and reward rules. Check the details below!

📈Ranking Mechanics:
In the updated Grand Gladiator Arena, ranking up is now faster and more dynamic. The old tier system has been replaced with a real-time server ranking. Defeat an opponent ranked higher than you, and your rankings will swap. If you lose, your ranking remains unchanged. Achieve a new all-time high ranking and receive 10 Wyrmarrows for every 100 ranks gained. All players start at rank 15,000.

🎁Ranking Rewards:
Rewards are distributed via mail at 2:00 AM (UTC+0) based on the latest rankings.

🌌Other Changes:
Champion Invitation:
Champion Invitations no longer generate over time. They reset to 10 at 6:00 AM (UTC+0) daily. Players can purchase up to 10 additional Invitations per day for 10 Wyrmarrows each.
Quick Challenge:
When challenging a lower-ranked player, the Quick Challenge feature lets you win instantly and earn rewards like Wyrmarrows, EXP Potions, Gold, and Gladiatorial Seals.
Grand Gladiator Arena Shop Improvement:
Item purchases in the Grand Gladiator Arena no longer require reaching specific tiers, though this change does not apply to the Team-based Arena.
Speed Battle:
A Speed Battle feature has been added, significantly reducing battle completion times.
Matchmaking Improvement:
The new matchmaking system enhances the wait times and outcomes for matchups.
Top 10 Lineups:
View the top 10 players in the Grand Gladiator Arena on your server. By scrolling to the far left of the challenge list, you can see their defensive lineups and hero positions, offering insight into top PvP strategies.

notes.title: A Letter to Travelers
notes.content:
Today, we have ushered in the first major content adjustment for the new version. This "S1 Special Optimization" mainly includes the following contents: the redesign of "Chaos Universum", the reward distribution of the S1 main storyline, the level and difficulty adjustment of the Fey Meander and multiple Dungeons, the design of "Elemental Affinity" skill tree in "Psychicore", and other experience improvements for new Travelers, etc. Before its official release to the public, we are nervous but also relatively confident in this adjustment, since these targeted adjustments are based on considerable feedback from numerous long-term supporters of "Dragonheir: Silent Gods".
Considering this "S1 Special Optimization" covers many gameplay reward increases, and separately compensates S1 Travelers, we fully understand the feelings and frustration of S2 and S3 players. We are here to clarify certain misunderstandings:

1. Due to the complicated design of the game system and after careful consideration, we believe the series of adjustments starting from the S1 to be the most feasible way to implement changes. We will try our utmost to ensure that S2 and S3 players will not be interrupted by sudden extensive changes during the season, which would probably create a strong sense of fragmentation. As for the development of future versions, we will roll out improvements based on the feedback collected as of the current adjustment is applied to the S1 so that it can be better adapted and applied to other seasons.

2. New Travelers are the guarantee of an inexhaustible source of vitality. However, veteran Travelers are the core driving force for our long-term development and operation. We learned that Travelers in S2 and subsequent seasons may be confused for not receiving equivalent compensation to that for Travelers in S1. Please do not worry, because we will synchronize the relevant updates to all S2 and S3 servers when we have received sufficient feedback from players in the S1. S2 and S3 Travelers will no doubt receive compensation soon.

As mentioned above, due to the complex game design, expanding adjustments to all seasons at once will greatly increase the pressure on subsequent adjustments and their verification process. Therefore, regarding the specific time when this "S1 Special Optimization" will be synchronized to other seasons, please wait patiently for our follow-up announcements. More feedback and data observations are required to support our expectation: "Good things are well worth the wait." We sincerely expect your patience and understanding.
The Dragonheir Team will spare no effort to ensure a better gaming experience for every Traveler. Thank you all for your encouragement, support, and understanding as always.

notes.title: 📢 TavernTalk: Player-Devs Q&A! 🤔
notes.content:
Dear Travelers!
Now, travelers who are advancing swiftly have reached the conclusion of Season 2! Rest assured, we have prepared ample content for Season 3, in addition to system upgrades and optimizations, let’s see what they are!
Additionally, the developers of Dragonheir: Silent Gods will keep listening to your voice. They are here to answer some of the most discussed questions from you.

[b]About New Content:[/b]
Q: Will there be more Kinsfolk and gender in the future? Like female Elves, Dwarfs, male Human andl Lizardfolk?
A: We will be bringing male Highlanders to the game in a future update.

Q: The disparity between the top ten and the first place is minimal. It is hoped that the players ranked first, second, and third could be awarded a special, unique avatar frame, lasting 90 days. This signifies that if you wish to retain it, you must compete again in the subsequent season. This could bring something to the best players to chase after, without affecting the majority of players.
A: We got you! We have planned to add vanity items and badges like exclusive profile pictures, only available to the best of the best to show off! In addition,
We are also considering adding more achievement related cosmetics, such as profile frames and dice skins. More concrete information will be shared in future annoucements, stay tuned!

[b]Game Mode Optimizations:[/b]
Q: Can we have a max option in enhancements? It is a pain to drag 1 to 20 every time we enhance our items.
A: Thank you traveler for the suggestion, such quality of life updates will be brought to the game soon.

Q: Endgame at each season is too long and repetitive! Taking on the same bosses every day, Affinity Solvents loses their value after reset... Maybe we could have more content in the last 3 weeks at the end of every season? Along with more speed-up options to lessen our pain of leveling our heroes after each reset.
A: Gotcha! We will bring more content to the end of seasons to make it more compelling, and we are already in development with speed-up options to make leveling more painless. We are open to more suggestions from you travelers.

Q: The Fey Meander is just the same thing every season, boring and repetitive, and the rewards aren’t even that good.
A: Sorry hear that, we have planned to have players spend less of their time in the Fey Meander. Other than keeping the exploration aspect in the Labyrinth of Curiosities, the Fey Meander will only contain one stage per floor. We have also adjusted the rewards to make it more compelling, with a new reward based on the daily highest achieved floor. However, the new reward system is still subject to change.

Q: The Dungeon is another repetitive aspect of the game, spending over 80% of our time raiding Goblin Lairs for EXP Potions to level our heroes, can we get more ways to obtain EXP Potion (from map exploration or maybe from the Fey Meander) so we don’t get burnt out?
A: We have planned for double drop events in the future, and Challenge Tickets can also be obtained in more ways than now. Additionally, we are also considering adding an idle leveling feature in the Camp, where up to 3 heroes can be selected to gain EXP passively over time.

[b]Other Content:[/b]
Q: Can we have more ways to obtain Shard heroes like Utior and Ardreth? Like exchanging for them in the Season Shop?
A: This is also in our plan! Utior is expected to be in the Season Shop at the end of Season 3, which of course will also offer items for Utior inspiration leveling.


Thank you all for submitting your feedback. As always, the developers will read your comments and suggestions while designing changes and updates accordingly. We encourage you to submit your feedback via our customer support. Just log into the game, go to Settings, and tap the customer support icon.


That's about it for this Q&A session. A big thank-you to everyone who made their voice heard. Adenthia is a more enchanting place because of you! Meanwhile, we encourage you to send your feedback and suggestions on various platforms. The Dragonheir: Silent Gods team will do its best to polish the game according to your expectations and bring you a more awesome gaming experience.

notes.title: 📢 TavernTalk: Player-Devs Q&A! 🤔
notes.content:
Dear Travelers!
Lately, we introduced our second collaboration event with Dungeons & Dragons, which brings a lot more in-game content and benefits. As always, we received great feedback from our players, and the developers are always listening to your thoughts on the new season. We've upgraded and optimized some features and settings in recent days. Let's see what they are!
Hero Guide: Players can visit the Hero interface and tap the Guide icon in the bottom right of any hero to directly view their guide published by our game team, recommended lineups of DPS heroes, and reviews from players. This can help you better understand which heroes to develop and add to your team.
 
Team Management: We added a page for you to manage your team. You can head there to edit your default lineup, edit the skill timing, and reorder your team.
 
Other Feature Optimizations: Currently, you can create up to 10 tabs using the Collection feature and add your favorite heroes to each of those tabs. While in the Dungeon interface, you can tap the View Info button to learn more about how to defeat the bosses. In the Deployment interface and Defeat page, there are now also tips to help you get the better of those bosses. Before a battle begins while you are selecting heroes, there is now a filter for you to filter heroes by their roles and categories.
 
 
 
Additionally, the developers of Dragonheir: Silent Gods will keep listening to your voice. They are here to answer some of the most discussed questions from you.
 
About Heroes:
 
Q: I hope I get to learn more about how to develop my heroes directly in the game. For example, I wish to know which sets and Artifacts suit me the most.
A: We've implemented a Hero Guide system for you to check what equipment and lineups we recommend. Please refer to the image to see how you can access this system. Meanwhile, you can view the players' comments and ratings for this hero.
 
 
 
Game Mode Optimizations:
Q: I hope players can borrow heroes from their friends to participate in events or play special stages.
A: That's a great idea! It's a common feature in other games for you to "help" each other. Not only that, we have other social features under development, so stay tuned to our updates and announcements. When the feature goes live, we'll inform you in an online patch note.
 
Q: Some of the Fey Meander stages are too difficult. For example, in stage 154 and stage 171, Grishnaar is basically stronger than the boss. I hope only the boss is hard to deal with and not the minions as well.
A: The higher floors of the Fey Meander are designed to challenge hardcore players to come up with better strategies, so it's normal that casual players will find them more difficult. We received feedback saying the Fey Meander game mode is not fun enough, and we are currently working on this problem. We'll come back with more updates about this game mode, so please bear with us while you wait.
 
Q: I hope to see recommended lineups when playing a Boss Challenge, and I hope there is a filter to "show only the heroes I own."
A: Thank you for the suggestion. Such accessibility features are under development, and we'll introduce more similar adjustments and optimizations in the future.
 
Q: In the Information interface, I can only see what time a boss's skill will be recharged and not which skill the boss will use first. I hope to see more useful information about the bosses.
A: We've optimized and upgraded that interface. You can now learn more about the gameplay content via the Information interface. Additionally, we've added tips and hints to the Deployment interface and the Defeat page helping you understand how you can better tackle the bosses.
 
Other Content:
Q: I hope the game can tell me more specifically about how I can participate in an event or obtain rewards. For example, in the Reunion in Spring event, the players actually had to invite three players to earn three Heliolite Dice instead of inviting only one player and logging in three days. Also, the eligible players only include those who have been offline for more than 14 days.
A: Thank you for the feedback! It is true that our descriptions for some events can be further clarified. We'll look into this and do a full check to solve this issue.
 
Q: I hope to be able to obtain more Multiplied Challenge Tickets from events.
A: Roger that. We'll adjust the event rewards accordingly to make sure that you can get more Multiplied Challenge Tickets in future patches.
 
Thank you all for submitting your feedback. As always, the developers will read your comments and suggestions while designing changes and updates accordingly. We encourage you to submit your feedback via our customer support. Just log into the game, go to Settings, and tap the customer support icon.
 
 
 
That's about it for this Q&A session. A big thank-you to everyone who made their voice heard. Adenthia is a more enchanting place because of you! Meanwhile, we encourage you to send your feedback and suggestions on various platforms. The Dragonheir: Silent Gods team will do its best to polish the game according to your expectations and bring you a more awesome gaming experience.

notes.title: TavernTalk: Player-Devs Q&A I
notes.content:
Dear Travelers!
Season 2 is halfway through. We are delighted to see you so active in Adenthia. To thank you for your love and support, we've added more in-game content and benefits, including:
•Lunar Halo Convergence: This event offers three game modes: Moonlight Dungeon, Summon to Get Shards, and Continental Challenge, which can yield lots of growth materials and Lunar Halo Shards. By collecting Lunar Halo Shards, you can exchange them for Heliolite Dice, Starlight Stone Dice, Ardreth (a legendary hero), and other rare rewards from the Lunar Halo Shop!
•Quick Combat: We added Multiplied Challenge Tickets, which you can earn from Moonlight Dungeon and other events. This item lets you spend 2x Stamina and earn double the settlement rewards from quick combat.

Additionally, the developers of Dragonheir: Silent Gods heard your voice. They are here to answer some of the most discussed questions from you:

About Heroes:
Q: I hope the NPC, Mutated Sacredeia, can one day become a playable hero for us to draw and collect.
A; [Sacredeia] is indeed a new hero in the making. You'll meet her soon. Generally speaking, most of the in-game NPCs will eventually become playable heroes of various rarities, so stay tuned for news about the design of this hero.

Q: Some elements are imbalanced, especially Necrosis which is too weak. I hope the game can see more balance-related changes.
A: Balancing issues are also on top of our priority list, and we are aware that we haven't made a lot of changes when it comes to hero balancing.
However, for future new heroes, we will prioritize designing more powerful heroes for the weaker elements, so stay tuned.

Q: Rose fails as a healer in Temporal Vortex. I hope you can improve this hero.
A: Roger that. Regarding this, we're already planning to make updates to this hero. More details will be announced soon.



About Game Modes:
Q: Temporal Vortex and 3v3 team-based arena games take too long. I hope we can speed up these battles too.
A: Roger that! We're hard at work developing relevant features. Meanwhile, we encourage you to share more feedback with us.

Q: I hope there are more filter options for the Gallery feature, such as Buff Dispels, Debuff Dispels, and Healing so we can find the ones we want easier and faster.
A: Thank you for the suggestion. We'll see which filter options you use the most and add them to the Gallery.

Q: I think it's a good idea to add more game modes that require teamwork.
A: We are developing new team-based game modes, so stay tuned!

Q: I think it's a good idea to make surplus Imprint Stones useful.
A: We have something planned for you to use your surplus Imprint Stones, so please be patient with us and stay tuned for relevant news.


About Updates:
Q: It takes quite some time to clear stages. Do you have plans to resolve this and make things move faster?
A: Of course. Regarding this, we've implemented a Quick Combat: Multiplied Challenge feature. You can play events such as Moonlight Dungeon to earn Multiplied Challenge Tickets to access this feature. Additionally, we have other plans to speed up your in-game progress. Your ideas and suggestions matter in this regard, so keep them coming.
Step #1: Access the Quick Combat menu here.

Step #2: Enable the Multiplied Challenge feature here. By spending Multiplied Challenge Tickets, you will spend double the Stamina but also get double the rewards.


Q: Season 2 hasn't offered enough new content, and things can get repetitive and boring. I hope to see more new in-game content!
A: We've received feedback from many players about the lack of content in season 2, and the seasonal mechanics only make matters worse. Currently, the developers are hard at work trying to develop more seasonal content with high-replay value.
Additionally, the in-game trailer of our second collaboration event is now available! The D&D collaboration hero this time is Elminster, who will be here to meet you on February 23!

Q: The game has almost no events or rewards planned for Lunar New Year. Not only that, season 2 lacks events for us to upgrade or rebuild our teams, and there are only a few new maps. I hope the developers can focus on these issues.
A: The seasonal EXP mechanic has more potential to be explored, and the game development has indeed come to a bottleneck. But rest assured because our goals and expectations for the game remain unchanged. In season 2, we realized how important it is to add more unique, in-depth content to each new season.

Thank you all for submitting your feedback. As always, the developers will read your comments and suggestions while designing changes and updates accordingly. We encourage you to submit your feedback via our customer support. Just log into the game, go to Settings, and tap the customer support icon.



That's about it for this Q&A session. A big thank-you to everyone who made their voice heard. Adenthia is a more enchanting place because of you! Meanwhile, we encourage you to send your feedback and suggestions on various platforms. The Dragonheir: Silent Gods team will do its best to polish the game according to your expectations and bring you a more awesome gaming experience.

notes.title: Dragonheir: Silent Gods - Season 2 Q&A
notes.content:
Dear Adenthia Travelers:
　　Greetings! The Chaos Clepsydra is about to be inverted, and Season 1 of Dragonheir: Silent Gods is coming to an end. Over the Season, we have watched as you travelers met new Hero companions and faced challenges with fellow Alliance members. It brings us great pleasure to see your passion and enjoyment of the game and its various gameplay modes.
　　As we have promised, we will be expanding upon the story and various gameplay content, as well as making adjustments to the game according to your feedback.
　　Near the end of Season 1, we would like to answer some of the questions you have been asking us about the new Season.

[b][Story][/b]
Q1: Can I still experience the Main Quests and Side Quests in Season 2, if I haven't completed them in Season 1?
A1: We will be introducing a brand-new quest system in Season 2, but the one-time quests available in Season 1 will no longer be available once the Season is over, so be sure to experience them before they're gone for good!
Q2: Will the story receive updates in Season 2?
A2: Of course! Season 2 will feature a whole new Main Quest, new Side Quests, and Exploration content. We will also be looking at revamping some gameplay mechanics of the old map to improve adventurers' early-game experience.

[b][Seasonal Reset][/b]
Q1: Which items will be kept in Season 2?
A1: In the game, you can view the reservation rules for items of each category. We recommend adventurers check out Clepsydra Trail for a detailed description of how various items will be reset and which items will be kept.
Q2: Can I reset Heroes' Skill Levels in the new Season?
A2: As detailed in the rules in Clepsydra Trail, during the first 144 hours in each season, you can reset your heroes' level and have your invested resources refunded. However, Heroes' skill levels cannot be reset.
Q3: After the Season resets, are we going to have to experience another long grind to level up?
A3: As we have mentioned, we want to use Seasons to highlight the Card RPG experience, to remove the tiresome dungeon grinds with more achievable goals, as well as to emphasize three aspects of the gameplay experience: The early-game grinds, quick character building, and the strategic tackling of challenges. We will continue to observe and try to strike a fun balance among these three aspects.
Q4: Will Alliances stay in the new Season?
A4: Existing Alliances will be disbanded in the new season, and adventurers must create a new Alliance and start from scratch in the new season.

[b][Updates and Improvements][/b]
Q1: Will there be new Heroes in Season 2?
A1: Season 2 will introduce 3 new playstyles, namely, Burn, Ice Blast, and Thunderbolt, and 30 new Heroes in total. We hope this provides a richer experience as you come up with comps and strategies against various opponents.
Q2: Having to build Heroes from scratch every Season takes a lot of time. Will adjustments be made to the repetitive content?
A2: We are working on various solutions to make the experience less repetitive, such as reducing the time needed to engage in repeating content to make sure you have enough time to experience other fun parts of the game.

[b][Other Updates][/b]
Apart from the aforementioned content, we will also be making adjustments and improvements in other aspects of the game. Here are some examples:
● Server Invitation
- In season 1, the feature to invite friends into the same server was only available to Alliances, but now that we have made it easier for new players to catch up on the in-game progress, this feature will become available to individual players as well.
- New players cannot directly access season 2 because they are too far behind on in-game progress than the veteran players. They must at least run through some in-game content before they can join in on the latest fun.
● Other Improvements
- Leader Impeachment
Once the Leader has been offline for 7 days, the Vice Leader can start an impeachment to ensure the benefit of all the Alliance members.
- Alliance Chat
Chat messages from other Alliance members will be retained even when you are offline.
● Benefits
- Season 1 Settlement Hero Pool
We will be opening a Settlement Hero Pool: Season Forthfaring Summons. The number of summons available in this Pool will be decided by Season 1 settlements. Every 10 summons guarantees at least 1 Legendary Hero. In addition, this pool has a high chance of turning up new Season 2 Heroes.
- Season 2 Exclusive Hero Pool
At the same time, two weeks before the new Season begins, another Hero Pool that features only new Season 2 Heroes will be opened. In this Pool, you can get all new Season 2 Heroes, including the new SPs [Exclusive Artifact Heroes] Beldelle, Perkunte, and Aschetius.

　　Thank you all for supporting Dragonheir: Silent Gods. We would greatly appreciate it if you would continue to play in the upcoming Season and keep giving us feedback and suggestions. We will continue to observe, listen, and improve, as you embark on exciting adventures in the new Season.
　　We look forward to seeing you in [Fall of Increscent] and witnessing the continuation of your epic in Adenthia!
