notes.title: [S0 -> S1] Sept. 15th All-server Season Settlement Preview
notes.content:
Greetings, Travelers!
Thank you for continuing to support our game! We value every Traveler's feedback and suggestions, and are pleased to hereby announce:
All Travelers participating in this paid-content-retained Closed Beta will be granted access to the new [b][S1][/b] content on [b]September 16th, 2023 at 02:00 (UTC+0)[/b].

Details and clarifications on S1 plans and new content ahead of the rollout are as follows:

[h2]〓 Season Settlement Preview 〓[/h2]
[olist]
[*] For a fair and ordered game environment, we plan to commence the [b][S0][/b] settlement on [b]September 15th, 2023 at 00:00 (UTC+0)[/b] for all 24 servers launched during the paid-content-retained Closed Beta.
[*] Since this is the first-ever season settlement during the test phase of Dragonheir: Silent Gods, service will be suspended [b]from September 15th, 2023 at 00:00 to September 16th, 2023 at 01:59 (UTC+0)[/b] due to the complexity of the settlement process. Travelers will not be able to log in to the game during this maintenance period.
[/olist]
※ We are aware this may cause Travelers some inconvenience, but the simultaneous [b][S0][/b] settlement aims to deliver more new content and a better gaming experience as soon as possible. We believe this move will make for an even more rewarding, fun game.

[h2]〓 Notes 〓[/h2]
* The following notes refer specifically to the [S0] gameplay features.

[h3]◉ Otherworld Exploration ◉[/h3]
As per the scheduled maintenance shutdown start (00:00, September 15th, 2023, UTC+0), the final server opened in this Beta, Decrescent, will initiate the settlement of Otherworld Exploration on September 14th, 2023 at 00:00 (UTC+0). It means that Travelers on that server will no longer have access to challenges in Otherworld Exploration as of September 14th, and will only be eligible to collect the rewards. Rewards will only be available until September 14th, and cannot be claimed after that date.

[h3]◉ Temporal Vortex ◉[/h3]
Damage Ranking Rewards for Temporal Vortex will be available until September 14th, 2023 at 23:59 (UTC+0) and will be unavailable after that time.

[h3]◉ Sparkle Tournament ◉[/h3]
As of September 14th, 2023 at 23:59 (UTC+0), Alliances that participated but have failed to settle will be unable to receive the due rewards.

[h3]◉ Grand Arena ◉[/h3]
As of September 14th, 2023 at 23:59 (UTC+0), including "Grand Gladiator Arena" and "Champion Arena", Travelers that participated but have failed to settle will be unable to receive the due rewards.

[h3]◉ Limited Events ◉[/h3]
[b]1. Hard Training XII[/b]
As of September 14th, 2023 at 23:59 (UTC+0), Travelers will be unable to receive rewards if the settlement on their servers has not yet been completed. Please pay special attention to these event deadlines!
[b]2. One Step Ahead[/b]
As of September 14th, 2023 at 23:59 (UTC+0), if Travelers fail to complete all event quests, please don't worry. Actual progress will be carried over once [S1] begins. However, Travelers who have already completed all event quests will be unable to continue participating after [S1] begins. Travelers are advised to claim their event rewards promptly!

[h3]◉ Mail ◉[/h3]
Once [S1] begins, Travelers' mailboxes will be cleared and all past mails will be deleted. If you have any unclaimed mail rewards, please collect them before September 14th, 2023 at 23:59 (UTC+0).

[h3]◉ Heliolite Summoning ◉[/h3]
Permanent [Heliolite Summoning]: Travelers who failed to trigger the Guaranteed Summon in [S0] will have their summon counts carried over to [S1]. For example, if a Traveler has performed Heliolite Summoning 34 times in [S0] without triggering the Guaranteed Summon, when [S1] begins, the next Heliolite Summoning will guarantee a Legendary Hero.

[h2]〓 S1 Season Early Access 〓[/h2]
After the [S0] settlement is completed, all Travelers who participated in this paid-content-retained Closed Beta can choose to experience the new [S1] content [b]from September 16th, 2023 at 02:00 to September 18th, 2023 at 23:59 (UTC+0)[/b]. At that time, one server will be opened in advance for Travelers with existing characters to decide whether or not to start experiencing [S1] immediately.
* Travelers who failed to choose in time or prefer to start [S1] after the Global Launch, may choose a new server after [b]September 19th, 2023 at 00:00 (UTC+0)[/b], at which time you can inherit your original character's data ([b]most inherited data will be issued upon entering the [Chaos Universum], instructions will be given at that time, refer to in-game prompts for details[/b]).

[h2]〓 Price Changes to In-game Purchases 〓[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Dragonheir: Silent Gods will be launched simultaneously across multiple platforms globally. To ensure consistent in-game pricing across all platforms in all regions, we will adjust the pricing uniformly according to the latest exchange rates and VAT in each region, based on the US Dollar pricing. The final price should be in line with the actual price of in-game goods. We will also make necessary changes occasionally per changes to platform policies, any of which will be clearly communicated to you before each change.
[*] During this Closed Beta, we received an avid response and suggestions from many Travelers regarding pricing. Following those suggestions and careful consideration, we have decided to change the price of the "Three Ears Daily Supply" from $9.99 to $4.99 once [S1] starts (pack contents have been updated). Travelers who purchased this product during the Beta will be refunded the price difference once [S1] begins. Compensation will be issued to the respective character's mail, so make sure to check accordingly.
[/olist]

[h2]〓 Global Launch Time 〓[/h2]
Dragonheir: Silent Gods will be launched simultaneously across multiple platforms on September 19th, 2023 at 00:00 (UTC+0). The Global Launch will be available on PC, Android, iOS, and macOS platforms, as well as future releases on the Steam Store and Epic Store. Please check official announcements for details!

[h2]〓 Server Opening Campaign 〓[/h2]
[b]1. Pre-registration Event: One Step Ahead[/b]
Thank you to all our Travelers for your enthusiastic pre-registration across all official platforms! After the Global Launch, Travelers who complete specified quests will be rewarded handsomely! Rewards include the Legendary Hero: Big Horn - Errich!
[b]2. Prestart Summons Event: Otherworld Horn[/b]
Travelers can search the Google Play Store and the App Store for "Dragonheir Pre-gift". Installation will grant you access to the "Otherworld Horn" Prestart Summons campaign. The final event reward will be the hero you ultimately select during the event.
* The deadline for the Prestart Summons event is September 17th, 2023 23:59 (UTC+0), so Travelers are encouraged to participate promptly!
* The reward will be issued from September 19th, 2023 02:00 (UTC+0). Travelers should log in to the official game client with a third-party account associated with the event. The reward will be sent via mail to the first character that reaches Journey Lv. 5, so keep an eye out!

>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>
[h2]Considering that some Travelers still have doubts about S1 Early Access regarding the previous announcement, we would like to address all relevant questions here:[/h2]
[olist]
[*] For [b]Travelers who have participated in S0[/b], you will enter the server for S1 Early Access — [Chaos Clepsydra I] if you log in to the game [i]between 02:00 on September 16, 2023 and 23:59 on September 18, 2023 (UTC+0)[/i]. This server will only be available to S0 players. Since all players are expected to be familiar with the gameplay, and their Player Characters will be carried over to the new season, we anticipate a fast-paced gaming experience with intense competition on this server, making it suitable for Travelers who seek challenges.
[*] For [b]Travelers who have participated in S0[/b], [Fountain Interplanar I] and [Fountain Interplanar II] will become available starting at [i]00:05 on September 19, 2023 (UTC+0)[/i]. New Travelers who did not participate in S0 will also gain access to these two servers. On these servers, S0 Travelers can act as guides, assisting new players in getting started more swiftly. This option benefits both newcomers in need of guidance and players who want to enjoy the game with their friends.
[*] For [b]Travelers who have not participated in S0[/b], you can pre-download the game client on [i]September 18, 2023[/i], and commence with the beginner tutorial and character customization on [Chaos Clepsydra II] or other servers. On this server, S0 Traverlers will not be able to carry over their Player Characters created in S0. Therefore, this server will be a perfect starting line for absolute fair play.
[/olist]
- Both S0 Travelers and S1 newcomers can freely choose a server that best suits their needs.
- Only pre-download, server selection, beginner tutorial and character customization are available on [i]September 18, 2023[/i]. The official server launch remains scheduled for [i]00:05 on September 19, 2023 (UTC+0)[/i].

If you have any questions or suggestions, please do not hesitate to reach out to us through customer support! Thank you once again for your continued understanding and support!

notes.title: Global Launch Q&A
notes.content:
🌟Dear Travelers, before Dragonheir's global launch, we noticed that many Travelers still had some questions about the new version. We've collected some FAQ that you may have and provided you with answers to them. We sincerely hope it will address your questions. And for detailed information, please check our Discord channel.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/ba28a76a1054bc26db4bbd5f202519b7231333a7.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/19550a09cb608f6bc1161fa0805fd1c70eab2bf2.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/94c20a70209daa06a1045f5d2651db833850ef4b.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/1316df13d3c87dd83a815d680f1bd5e1b98fa7bd.png[/img]
💫Dragonheir: Silent Gods will be globally launched on September 19th! Pre-register NOW: https:/dragonheir.nvsgames.com/dragonheir-pre-order


[i][b]>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>Check for more details>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>[/b][/i]

[h3]Server Maintenance Notification[/h3]
Thank you for continuing to support our game! We value every Traveler's feedback and suggestions, and are pleased to hereby announce:
[b]For a fair and ordered game environment, we plan to commence the [S0] settlement on September 15th, 2023 at 02:00 (UTC+0) for all 24 servers launched during the paid-content-retained Closed Beta.[/b]

Since this is the first-ever season settlement during the test phase of Dragonheir: Silent Gods, service will be suspended from[b] September 15th, 2023 at 02:00 to September 16th, 2023 at 01:59 (UTC+0)[/b] due to the complexity of the settlement process. Travelers will not be able to log in to the game during this maintenance period.

We are aware this may cause Travelers some inconvenience, but the simultaneous [S0] settlement aims to deliver more new content and a better gaming experience as soon as possible. We believe this move will make for an even more rewarding, fun game.

[b]〓 Notes 〓
After the [S0] settlement is completed, all Travelers who participated in this paid-content-retained Closed Beta can choose to experience the new [S1] content from September 16th, 2023 at 02:00 to September 18th, 2023 at 23:59 (UTC+0). At that time, one server will be opened in advance for Travelers with existing characters to decide whether or not to start experiencing [S1] immediately.[/b]


[h3]Overview - Dragonheir: Silent Gods Global Launch Updates and Optimizations[/h3]
Hello, fellow Travelers! Dragonheir: Silent Gods will be holding its global Global Launch soon, and servers will go online on September 19, at 00:05 (UTC+0). But before that, we are here to tell you all about our Global Launch's content updates and optimizations. We hope this will introduce our game at its finest to every new visitor in Adenthia!

[h3]New Heroes To Boost Your Adventurer Lineup![/h3]
After this update, you will see numerous new Heroes available for your choosing, including King of Desolation - lrzillas and Wings of Dawn - Lucien. There are a total of 80 Heroes. Among them, 17 are Legendary Heroes and 36 are Epic Heroes. There will also be new skill mechanics and stunning character models. These Heroes are at your disposal and ready to follow you on your adventure!
Also, there is a seasonal exclusive Hero, Empire's Shadow - Utior, the humanoid form of a Violet Dragon. This Hero will be available for you to obtain in the mid-season event, Imperial Shadow Recast. By playing the game, you can earn Shadow Amethysts, which you can use to exchange for the Legendary Hero, Utior.

[h3]Server Invitation - Explore Adenthia Together[/h3]
The Alliance feature has to do with many game modes in Dragonheir: Silent Gods. It is every Traveler's wish to find their favorite Alliance, and we would like to make that easier for our players.
After this update, you'll see the new Alliance Invitation feature. Each Alliance Leader will see a Server Invitation icon in the Alliance main menu. Tap that icon to access a new page, and you can generate a server invitation code that is valid for 7 days. When another player joins your server, they can go to the Server Invitation tab and enter your invitation code when they create a new character. This way, they will be taken to the server where your Alliance is.
[b]Notes:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Your Alliance must be Lv.2 to unlock this feature.
[*] An invitation code can be used for an unlimited number of times. Once it expires, the Alliance Leader can simply generate a new one.
[*] The Server Invitation feature will only be available during Season 1.
[*] Players who get invited must first link to a third-party account. Also, the target server must still have room for more players for you to enter the invitation code and create a character there.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/8611a58b36a5b149aa71caab4de7a9ae27b67ddd.png[/img]

[h3]Elf Rose, Your In-game Helper[/h3]
Once you have completed the first stage of the storyline and arrived at Fog Town, you'll automatically unlock the Elf feature.
Along your adventure, should you have any questions, you can ask our Elf. Also, once this Elf senses that you are stuck, she'll help you come up with a solution. The first time you play a stage and fail, you'll receive a notification from the Elf feature that helps you adjust your strategies.
● Tap UNFOLD in the upper right to unfold the bottom left section of the screen where you'll see the icon to access the Elf feature.
● We encourage you to explore the game by yourself first. This is how you can fully enjoy and immerse yourself in the fun of this game. We also hope the Elf feature will never fail to answer your questions. In the updates that follow, we'll continue to improve the Elf feature so it becomes an encyclopedia for you.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/043fcccbced216f6353424357c4976240dfaa769.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/2f7e77604738c314c306ed53cbf081d5fb0d016d.png[/img]

[h3]Walker's Trails - It Helps Every Adenthia Traveler[/h3]
Have you been low on resources and progressing through the journey a bit too slowly?
After this update, there will be a Battle Pass system called Walker's Trails. We hope this will provide you with more battle resources and make your journey in Adenthia easier!
● Each season will have 3 sessions of Walker's Trails, each lasting 28 days.
● By completing Daily Quests and Weekly Quests, you can earn Travel EXP to level up your Walker's Trails and obtain more rewards.
● Other than the free basic rewards, you may also buy Walker's Selection to unlock more rewards. This one is really worth the price!

[h3]New GvG Gameplay; Fight To Become The Greatest Alliance![/h3]
In this update, we will add the new Alliance Battle mode called Golden Wing Points Match.
● Schedule: Every Tuesday and Wednesday, with each round lasting 2 days.
● During a match, Alliance members can earn points for their Alliance by completing dungeon stages, playing temporal vortex, or winning in Grand Gladiator Arena. When an Alliance has enough points, it will unlock milestone rewards. Eventually, the Alliance that has earned the most points wins the match.
[b]Notes:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Golden Wing Points Match and Sparkle Tournament are both available once per week, and they take turns to become available. Their participation requirements are the same: your Alliance must have at least 15 active members over the past three days.
[*] During Alliance Battle, new members will not be able to participate in this event. For those who have left their Alliance, the points they earned with their previous Alliance will stay with their previous Alliance, but they won't be eligible to receive follow-up rewards.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/ae43b1558f246a617c1c5bb295717ba5d622f4f0.png[/img]

[h3]Answer The Call Of Your Alliance To Earn Challenge Rewards![/h3]
After this update, you can directly play the temporal vortex challenge in the Alliance Rally menu, and more difficulty levels will be available for you to choose from. As you can expect, the rewards associated with each difficulty may vary. Additionally, we have made some adjustments to how points are tallied and how the reward mechanic works.
● Previously, this game mode keeps track of the damage you have dealt, but now it keeps track of the points you have earned and offers Alliance rewards based on those points.
● Players will receive Alliance Challenge points based on the amount of damage dealt to the boss. When an Alliance has enough points, it will unlock rewards for everyone.
*The points and reward progress are refreshed daily. Unclaimed rewards will be mailed to players instead.
*Alliance members who have not participated in the event on a day will not be eligible to receive the rewards that day.
*By fighting a boss on a higher difficulty, you will earn more points. On the same difficulty, you earn more points if you deal more damage.

[h3]Team Arena Now Available; Gameplay Just Got More Strategic[/h3]
After this update, the Grand Arena will introduce a 3v3 team-based mode called Team Arena.
Many Travelers thought the gameplay was too limited in the single-team Competitive Mode, and to ensure the power of their lineups, players would often have to give up on their chance to experiment with more interesting builds. However, that will change with this new mode where the increased number of teams will surely make the game more unpredictable and exciting. It is time to get creative!
● Format: In this mode, the participants must create three teams of 5 and take turns to fight.
● Participation Cost: Team Invitations (which is replenished by 1 every 2 hours, up to 10).
● Gameplay Rules: In this mode, players must set up their own defensive lineup and fend off other players or take the fight to them instead.
*Team Arena becomes available on the 22nd day of a season.
*What sets this apart from the Grand Gladiator Arena is that players must set up 3 teams for offense or defense. In a game, the result of each battle will affect your points and rewards. Whether you are on the offensive or defensive, upon victory, you'll get to raise your ranking and earn additional rewards.
*In Team Arena, the effect of Ultimate Energy Reduction is reduced to 50%. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/7b55c421e0eb6b2f4c158f487f6ba6c1f56f5eb2.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/cf606cc9b04e8eb5b3cca038870a0a1f4b6f4185.png[/img]

[h3]Optimized Competitive Mode For Better Combat Experience[/h3]
In this update, we have optimized the Grand Arena in many ways based on the feedback from our players.
● Hero Resonance: In the Grand Arena, the level of all your Heroes will be synced to match that of your highest-level Hero. This way, even your underdeveloped Heroes can become as powerful as they would be at high levels in this mode, which means it is more flexible for you to build your lineup.
● Exclusive Equipment Plan: In the Grand Arena, participants can set a separate Equipment Plan for this mode for all their Heroes so they won't have to keep switching equipment when accessing a different mode.
*After this update, when you play Competitive Mode for the first time, you will still have to configure your equipment again.
*The Equipment Plan of each Hero will be available either in Adventure Mode or Competitive Mode.
*You cannot upgrade or improve your Heroes in Competitive Mode.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/cf606cc9b04e8eb5b3cca038870a0a1f4b6f4185.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/f21e47433c4174eabcc726dedcb520a3d05e3fe5.png[/img]

[h3]Lineup Feature Now Available; Improved Hero Skill AI[/h3]
We have always been thinking about how to improve the combat experience for our players, and in this update, we will add some new features for that and make the in-game combat more convenient and satisfying.
● The Lineup Feature: Now, you can edit and save your lineup before you start playing. This feature is available in every dungeon.
*Currently, you can save up to 6 lineups.
● Customize The Timing For Hero Skills: Now, when Auto-combat is enabled, you can preset the timing of ultimate skills for your active Heroes.
*This feature is unavailable in all types of game modes in the Grand Gladiator Arena and some battles in the Sparkle Tournament (i.e. the Sharpteeth Gate, Heatwave Outpost, and the Eternal Three Ears).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/224b74bd354dd8d9a030525c2b264dddcd93cf9e.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/97a78d2c173f1a405c3e6827f9bc50f0fcfb3579.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/cda2e5cf29716997d010deb54641984e6274a2b2.png[/img]


[h2]More New Content And Optimizations[/h2]
[h3]Poetry Collect and Exchange[/h3]
After this update, there will be a Poetry Collect and Exchange Shop. By playing Reunion dungeons, you can get Pages of Legendary Poems and exchange them for various rewards.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/2e867d8757cc73945f3a28ec0e7b80682299f4f4.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/09da40a54142834ad7ef21c90037c1b4fee184c8.png[/img]

[h3]Avatar Frames[/h3]

notes.title: A Letter From Dragonheir: Silent Gods Developer — Global Launch Preview
notes.content:
[b]To Adenthia's pioneering Adventurers:[/b]

Greetings, one and all! As Dragonheir: Silent Gods S0 draws to a close, we have been grateful for your company for over two months now! Seeing so many Adventurers enthusiastically enjoying the immersion of our vibrant world and rich stories in tandem with highly strategic battles and versatile character line-ups has been a real pleasure for all of us here!
So many players have spoken fondly of their experience of the story and urged us to release story updates. Rest assured! This is only the beginning! Your adventures in Adenthia will brim with even more ambitious stories, with even more engaging, diverse content. We have been working tirelessly to bring even more new content that will be simultaneously launched with the Global Launch on September 19th!
Equally, we take player feedback and suggestions seriously! We aim to address any problems you encountered with our many improvements and adjustments newly implemented in the Global Launch. For any questions you may have about this new version, hopefully the following will clarify everything:
[h2][Map & Story][/h2]
[h3]Q1: Will there be any [New Maps] added to the Global Launch?[/h3]
A1: The [b]brand new Underground Sandbox[/b] will be coming to the Global Launch soon. It will feature [b]new challenges of both main quests and local quests[/b], ensuring players will have plenty of playable content by Mid-Season.
[h3]Q2: Will the [Story] be updated in the Global Launch?[/h3]
A2: To ensure players have a more immersive, rewarding and complete experience, we have added [b]a substantial amount to the storyline[/b] of the [b]Plains and Underground[/b] (new map!) in the [b]Global Launch[/b].

[h2][New Content & Adjustments][/h2]
[h3]Q1: When will the population [Lizardfolk] be available in the Player Character customization?[/h3]
A1: The moment you have all been waiting for, Adventurers! The new customizable lizardfolk will be launched simultaneously with the Global Launch, allowing you to pick this population for your newest playthrough!
[h3]Q2: Will any [New Heroes] be added to the Global Launch?[/h3]
A2: [b]Over 60 new heroes will be added[/b] to the Global Launch! Moreover, we will continue to update frequently in later Seasons to ensure players will always have new builds to explore.
[h3]Q3: Will [Elemental Affinity] in the Global Launch be different than that in the previous game version? How will it be changed?[/h3]
A3: Seasons are a key feature of our game. Each Season sees a rotation shift in Elemental Affinity and its rules, guaranteeing a different experience at all gameplay stages. In S1, [b][Fire & Poison][/b], [b][Radiance & Lightning][/b], and [b][Necrosis & Ice][/b] will form new pairings.
[h3]Q4: Some heroes don't have suitable [Artifacts], while some powerful artifacts cannot be assigned to multiple heroes at once.[/h3]
A4: We intended the artifact system to allow players to develop their heroes with greater flexibility and to choose their favored progression path. Therefore, we will continue introducing a wider range of artifacts for you to choose from. After the Global Launch is launched, [b]over 20 new artifacts will be introduced[/b]. We'll also [b]introduce more ways to acquire artifacts[/b], helping Adventurers progress more quickly.
[h3]Q5: There are not enough [Rewards] from quests and events, and some rewards cannot be obtained by average players in a reasonable amount of time.[/h3]
A5: We heard your feedback! In the Global Launch, we will be [b]improving reward content[/b] and [b]reducing the acquisition threshold for some rewards[/b], allowing players a smoother development path.
[h3]Q6: When I encounter [Difficulties] in-game, I often need to spend half the day working it out. Is there any better way to seek help?[/h3]
A6: Once the Global Launch is live, we will [b]launch a built-in AI Q&A Wizard[/b] to answer all sorts of everyday questions in-game, helping players jump into the game in no time!
[h3]Q7: There are too many heroes! Which heroes do you [Recommend for Development] early on? Who is the best choice for each different Dungeon?[/h3]
A7: Having more heroes to choose from can make strategic team building more fun, but it inevitably increases the training costs for new players. To address this issue, we will be [b]updating the Lineup Tips feature[/b] in the Global Launch. Players will be able to rate each card and provide their own lineup recommendations for different Dungeons. By [b]promoting communication and exchanges among players[/b], everyone's understanding of the game will be improved overall.

[h2][Dungeons][/h2]
[h3]Q1: Will there be any new [EXP Dungeon] besides Goblin Lair?[/h3]
A1: There'll be [b]a new EXP Dungeon[/b] in the Underground Sandbox giving players the room to experiment with AOE lineups and development rate. The Dungeon will feature a set number of monster waves, with rewards being granted according to the number of waves cleared. Adventurers that clear every wave will obtain all the rewards!
[h3]Q2: The [Dungeon Reward] items are limited, and some Dungeons are not challenging enough in the late game.[/h3]
A2: In the Global Launch, [b]new content will be added[/b] to the Pillar of Trial and the Fey Meander, posing players with even more of a challenge. We have also added a host of new rewards: limited legendary artifacts, limited epic heroes, and a number of [b]entirely exclusive rewards unobtainable through purchases[/b]! Even more beneficial, this Dungeon type will encourage players to experiment with and devise even better strategies for clearing Dungeons.
[h3]Q3: Will there be any other [New Dungeon] designs for the game?[/h3]
A3: Besides the regular Dungeons, the new [b]Season Dungeon[/b] will be introduced with the Global Launch. Players will be given advance notice before this Dungeon opens. We recommend that players prepare even more lineups to face the complex challenges that await! [b]Season Events[/b] will be launched Mid-Season, where you can acquire [b]limited legendary heroes and artifacts[/b]! These rewards are [b]exclusive to Season Dungeon and are not available through summons, purchase, or any other means[/b].
[h3]Q4: The [Alliance System] has very few quests and events. Will you consider adding more related activities?[/h3]
A4: We would like Alliance to hold a greater role in the game, promoting a sense of community and belonging among players. Since the official Global Launch, the [b]cap on Alliance members[/b] will be increased from the original 30 [b]up to 50[/b], and a [b]new Alliance PVP mode[/b] will be added. The [b]structure of Temporal Vortex will be revamped and corresponding Alliance rankings will be introduced[/b]. The challenge mode [b]difficulty selection will also be optimized[/b], allowing players to have more freedom in choosing their preferred difficulty.

[h2][PVP][/h2]
[h3]Q1: Will PVP be available cross-server in future?[/h3]
A1: We will [b]enable cross-server PVP when appropriate[/b], enriching the matchmaking experience for players. Availability is tied to a server's overall player progress, thereby avoiding excessive level disparities during cross-server matching.
[h3]Q2: Resources are limited in the early game! It's too difficult to [Simultaneously Train Multiple Lineups] for PVP![/h3]
A2: Of Dragonheir: Silent Gods' various PVP modes, Asynchronous PVP is a terrific strategy tester. But, one issue has given many players a headache [b]— the high cost of hero training. It makes putting together more lineups difficult[/b]. This pitfall will be addressed in the Global Launch: [b]The level of all a player's heroes will be synchronized to match the highest level hero they currently have. [/b]We believe that lower costs will help Adventurers develop more powerful combinations!
[h3]Q3: Will there be any [New PVP Mode] in the Global Launch?[/h3]
A3: PVP in the Global Launch version will [b]introduce a tag combat[/b]. Each player is required to assemble 3 lineups to compete. The strategy aspect will definitely be more thrilling!

[h2][Other Updates][/h2]
As well as the above, we have made other changes and improvements that we would like to share with our Adventurers:
[h3]●Payments[/h3]
When the Global Launch debuts, the [b]Pass Feature[/b] will also go live. This feature allows Adventurers to obtain [b]a lot of resources[/b] for free, as well as being able to pay to unlock more [b]rare items[/b]. This ensures that every player will receive a regular flow of rewards!
[h3]●Servers[/h3]
To welcome new players to Adenthia, we are further [b]enhancing our servers, increasing player capacity in each (from 10,000 to 50,000).[/b]
[h3]●Art & Graphics[/h3]
Compared to Close Beta Test 2, the [b]art in the Global Launch will be heavily iterated[/b]. Maps, monsters, loading pages, skills and summoning effects will all be optimized further, whilst [b]4K resolution will be supported for PC.[/b]

[h2][Season Reset, Off-Season and Server Merge][/h2]
Seasons in Adenthia run on [b]12–14-week[/b] cycles. At the end of a Season, Adventurers are rewarded according to their performance that Season, and after a brief pause, progress into a new Season.
In accordance with [b]Season reset[/b] guidance in-game, player data from S0 will be [b]fully retained, partly retained or completely cleared[/b] during S1 depending on the classification, as per the following:
[h3]●Fully Retained Content[/h3]
① [b]All Avatars and Avatar Frames[/b] obtained by the player.
② [b]Wyrmarrow, Dragon Crystals, Summon Dice, Skill Scrolls[/b] and unexpired [b]Monthly Cards[/b].
③ [b]Pure Sandcores[/b], all of which can be exchanged for appropriate rewards in the [b]Season Shop[/b].
*Note: At the start of a new Season, [b]Echo of Clepsydra[/b] acquired in the previous Season will be automatically converted to [b]Pure Sandcores[/b] at a [b]ratio of 100:1[/b].
[h3]●Partly Retained Content[/h3]
① [b]Heroes, Skill Levels, and Inspiration Levels[/b] will be retained, but the [b]Hero Level[/b] will be reset to Lv.1.
② [b]Artifacts[/b] will be retained, but the [b]Artifact Level[/b] will be reset to Lv.1.
③ [b]A certain percentage[/b] of [b]Essence of Creation[/b] obtained through Hero Summoning will be retained (consumed or not). Additionally, players will be rewarded with [b]extra Essence of Creation[/b] in the new Season [b]according to their in-game progress[/b].
④ [b]Unlocked Arcane Spells[/b] and [b]Attribute Points acquired[/b] by the Player Character will be retained and [b]can be reallocated[/b] at the start of a new Season.
[h3]●Fully Cleared Content[/h3]
① [b]Elemental Affinity Levels[/b] will be completely reset, in tandem with the rotation of Elemental Affinity rules in the new Season.
② [b]Mist will regenerate[/b] on the [b]Map[/b], requiring players to re-explore the world to unlock the various teleport sites.
[h3]●About This Off-Season[/h3]
The game is currently in the final stages of Global Launch [b](September 19th)[/b] preparation. After S0 ends[b] (August 22nd)[/b], we will have a relatively long [b]Off-Season[/b] to ensure that all players, new and old, are synchronized for S1 progression during the Global Launch. No new content or events will be available during this period, but players can continue to play.
[h3]●About Server Merge[/h3]
Since the official Global Launch, we will increase the player capacity of our new servers even further. [b]Servers involved in S0[/b] will be unified in a merge. [b]Detailed merge rules will be announced later[/b], so please stay patient and wait for the latest news!

Thank you all for showing Dragonheir: Silent Gods your interest and support! Our game will release its [b]Global Launch on September 19th[/b], at which time it will be [b]available on multiple platforms, including mobile and PC, with cross-platform data exchange[/b], and [b]support for 13 languages[/b].
We look forward to meeting you in Adenthia and writing a brand-new chapter in your saga!

notes.title: Baldur's Gate 3 meets Final Fantasy in new strategy RPG hitting Steam
notes.content:
You take the dice-driven, DnD-inspired combat of Baldur's Gate 3, where a single roll can mean the difference between death and glory, and you mix that with the gigantic boss encounters and lovingly crafted worlds of classic RPG games like Final Fantasy and Skyrim, and this is what you get. With a release date finally set, Dragonheir: Silent Gods, an open-world, strategy-based adventure with semi real-time and dice-based combat, is coming to Steam, and it feels like the combination of some of the best aspects of the greatest RPGs of the last 20 years.

notes.title: Dragonheir Silent Gods Beginner's Guide
notes.content:
[b][h1]Beginner's Guide - How to quickly progress through the early stages[/h1][/b]
Hello, Travelers!
Before you start your journey in Dragonheir:  Silent Gods, do check out the early game guides we prepared for beginners. It will help you get familiar with the game faster, get a solid start early on, and also help you avoid some problems and surprises.
[h2][b]Create your character to start an adventure full of unknowns[/b][/h2]
As an Traveler, you woke up from the <Soul Plane> without having a clue about the battle in the opening with the three-headed dragon god. To get back your memories and solve the mystery, you decided to gather companions and embark on an adventure full of unknowns. Dragonheir:  Silent Gods is a classic RPG with traditional settings. At the beginning and end of the prologue, you need to choose your race, appearance, origin and attributes, and get the corresponding check advantages for the various events you encounter on Adenthia.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/8b53507cae971ff2501447a5c535eecad6f7da88.png[/img]
[h2][b]Prioritize the Main Quest and level up your Journey Level[/b][/h2]
Follow the Dragonheir:  Silent Gods Main Quest to unlock new areas. Discover side quests and sandbox exploration content for the area in the meanwhile. This way, you can quickly get familiar with the game and also unlock more core features and gameplay.
The Main Quest will provide you with a large amount of travel experience, which can help you increase your Journey Level quickly. A higher Journey Level means more progress and a higher hero growth cap. Also, don't overlook the Daily Commission. Helping people in trouble on Adenthia can also provide you with a great deal of journey experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/609dab0fd8f39ded0f0eb0863674bf2d3881b9ed.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/81001a463e7d809c6f4b5acd326d6ba1c3ee8b02.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/469dc149336dd2f3ffc30a03f1f56d58f97ac120.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/38dbf2f7c9c3a69d1b5c35664d16cb13bdefcced.png[/img]
[b][h2]Ready to explore everything on your journey[/h2][/b]
Adenthia is full of surprises. Exploring hidden corners, solving ancient puzzles, gathering things and cooking, and completing commissions all offer rewards that will help you get further along in the Main Quest. Chaotic Temporal Sands will also reward those who love to explore. If you can earn a place in the leaderboard, you will be rewarded with a large amount of Dragon Crystals.
During your early exploration, it's recommended that you talk to as many NPCs as possible so that you can learn more about the continent, reveal hidden side quests, and even steal rare items. Don't forget to purchase a map from the Crimson Crow guide, which will be very helpful in your exploration.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/c99eaf12973307e0ca24f8a2c0aa2ce7db0334f4.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/014ec679c62ec0475698a9a17e6a66bd04ff63d7.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/ea91cbec317588edcd14d8f7b98d5ef3677b9c3a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/1385e0e410cf67f1e93aeb46b4011fb2a5a7661b.png[/img]
[b][h2]Check Journals to view your current progress[/h2][/b]
While you may be confused by the amount of content on Adenthia, journals will be a great help. Completing the quests in the [Adventures] tab will help you quickly learn all about hero growth and dungeons, and gain great rewards and journey experience, while the [Guide] tab lists your current to-do list, so remember to keep an eye on them!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/52e27f20a47ebbd8149eedd948d4b9009c50c2ec.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/721d782fa2b7b815df7ea3e348d8d182a7e9c84b.png[/img]
[h2][b]Consume your Stamina in time[/b][/h2]
Adenthia is dotted with dungeons where you can consume [b]Stamina[/b] to take on challenges and win EXP Potions, Elemental Crystals or equipment, all of which can greatly enhance your team. Your Stamina will recover over time, but anything over the cap will be wasted, so remember to convert your stamina into valuable resources in time.
Dragonheir:  Silent Gods has many planes. Players in pursuit of excellence can buy extra Stamina Bread to get ahead of other Plane Travelers!
[h2][b]Build your team according to hero attributes[/b][/h2]
In Dragonheir:  Silent Gods, each hero has unique skills and attributes. By building a team according to the heroes' attributes, you can make the most of their abilities.
[b][Element System][/b]
The heroes have six different element types: Necrosis, Radiance, Lightning, Poison, Fire and Ice. Each season, these six elements will be matched in pairs, and the two paired elements can trigger Elemental Affinity. When a certain number of heroes are added to the team according to their element types, they can enjoy the Elemental Affinity bonus and gain an attribute buff.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/f768cdbe944b59341d9167b2af99300036706cb0.png[/img]
[b][Hero Positioning][/b]
Hero positioning is divided into defense, support, and damage dealer, while the damage dealer is further divided into the following types: [b]Frost, Dauntless, Rally, Wild, Summon and Poisoned[/b]. Each type has a different method for damage output, different types of heroes placed in the same team cannot cooperate; while the same type of heroes can complement each other to achieve a higher damage output. Enter the game to view the damage output methods for each type and build a reasonable output structure.
Place your defense heroes in the front row and let them resist enemy damage.  Don't make any move without a healing hero. Some of the support heroes can heal other heroes to ensure that your team remains intact after a fierce battle.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/e43453c8118a364e198f2eaa0faff88c60cf01da.png[/img]
[h2][b]Cultivate your hero skillfully[/b][/h2]
When cultivating your heroes, remember to place the highest priority on leveling up. It will provide the most cost-effective boost to your hero's attributes and help you win those battles you haven't won yet. Get EXP Potions in the Goblin Lair Dungeon and use it to power up your hero. Get Elemental Crystals in the Elemental Domain to break through the level cap.
You don't have to be overly concerned about the quality of the equipment in the early stages. Just pick and choose from the equipment you have. As your hero levels up and equipment dungeons open, you should start focusing on the equipment, choosing the Primary Attribute of the breastplate and gauntlets for your hero based on their positioning. (Defense heroes need Defense or HP, support heroes may need Accuracy, and damage dealers will definitely need Attack!) Equip your heroes with the full set of equipment whenever possible to get extra bonuses for their attributes. Equipment enhancements provide a big upgrade but are also expensive, so be selective and invest in the equipment that has the attributes you need to make them the best boost for your hero! You can get equipment and runes in Catacomb Dungeons and Ruins Dungeons.
Whenever your hero gets an upgrade, remember to try to challenge dungeons of higher difficulty. Each difficulty increase in the dungeon will provide you with better rewards and help your hero get a further boost. Through this virtuous cycle, you will eventually be able to defeat all the enemies on Adenthia.
[h2][b]Cultivate your hero with a sense of direction[/b][/h2]
In Dragonheir:  Silent Gods, each hero has unique features that can be used to their advantage in the right places. As the game progresses, you may have acquired a certain number of heroes in various ways, and struggle to decide on which one to cultivate first, second, and so on. Here're some advice.
In the early stages, prioritize boosting heroes with the same elemental affinity. It gives heroes a large bonus to their attributes and helps you win battles more easily. However, as battles become more difficult, you will need heroes that offer unique mechanics against enemies that may not be on your original lineup, so consider dropping elemental affinities and adding these key heroes to your team.
We also recommend that you prioritize your resources early on with regard to heroes with a larger attack range. These heroes work better in the Main Quest and Goblin Lair battles, which will help you get through the beginner's phase easily. As more gameplay unfolds, heroes who are better at attacking individual enemies will have a place to shine.
Of course, you can also cultivate heroes according to your own preferences, since every hero in Dragonheir:  Silent Gods is very powerful!
[h2][b]Cultivate your heroes with tactics[/b][/h2]
In Dragonheir:  Silent Gods, you will face numerous battles that vary in nature, some of which place certain restrictions on the heroes you can deploy. For example, in elemental dungeons, as the difficulty rises, monsters gain resistance to certain attributes, and you need to strategically switch your deployed heroes to reduce the difficulty of the battle. As mentioned earlier, in Dragonheir:  Silent Gods, each hero has a place to shine. Try cultivating and replacing your deployed heroes whenever you encounter a difficult battle.
And don't worry that you may have committed your resources to the wrong heroes. We'll be offering a reshaping event in the first few days of the season where you can try out different heroes and find the ones you like the best!
[h2][b]Travelers may be the last piece of the puzzle[/b][/h2]
Travelers have unique in-game traits. They can switch elemental types, and the Traverlers under each elemental type have different skill effects. Consider changing the Traveler's element type when you are having trouble challenging a stage!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/fdc98d915968760a46c4ae892dddf5bf9387dfc1.png[/img]
[h2][b]Learn the enemy's strategy in advance and counteract it[/b][/h2]
Check the enemy's information before the battle starts, adjust the heroes' positions so that they can do their jobs, and develop countermeasures against the enemy's skills to achieve victory. Spread out to prevent your ally from being targeted by AoE skills, and put other heroes in the back row to let the enemy focus on the front row defense heroes.
After entering the battle, keep an eye on the enemy's skill release sequence and unleash the ultimate skill to counterattack.
Cultivate your hero, use the right strategy, and you will surely win!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/4b6c4a70c8ea77d77bb4a8852685498c463ce4e5.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/1b5056e81931f9864bd18297ec356197d177de6d.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/2e4222e311ea3e73bdf25fe2398e1fa2a3220061.png[/img]
[h2][b]Failure is a step towards success[/b][/h2]
Don't be discouraged if you fail. In Dragonheir:  Silent Gods, if you fail and quit, you will be refunded the resources you spent at the beginning of the challenge. You will incur no real loss. You can use defeat statistics to strengthen your team, switch to heroes better suited to dealing with your current enemies, or ask other Travelers for help.
 
So, those are some of the key points to keep in mind when you start playing Dragonheir: Silent Gods. I believe these tips will come in handy when you set foot on Adenthia.

notes.title: DragonHeir Gameplay & Event Introduction
notes.content:
As the game progresses, you can acquire various materials and resources. In addition, you can get numerous rewards by participating in events held regularly in the game.
You can get a large number of Heliolite Dice, Wyrmarrow, Master Scroll, and other rewards.
[b]Total Rewards:[/b] Get 150 Advanced Hero Summoning chances, valued at $750. In addition, get $200 worth of scrolls of various kinds for raising heroes as well as numerous training resources to help develop your own lineup.

[h3][b][*] Follow the Main Quest[/b][/h3]

notes.title: DragonHeir - CBT2 Update Content Overview
notes.content:
[b][h1]〓Major Update〓[/h1][/b]

[b][h2]1. Season [/h2][/b]
Added a Season framework and introduced reset rules to the sandbox and multiple systems. Settlement will be conducted on a seasonal basis, while the Season Shop will be opened. For more details about Season, please stay tuned to following announcements in our official communities.

[b][h2]2. Hero[/h2][/b]
1. Expanded the number of Heroes to over 110, including [u]15 newly added Legendary Heroes[/u] and [u]10 new Epic Heroes[/u].
2. Optimized Hero display interface. Labels of Hero Base have been added in order to provide players with guidance on the development direction before they start.
3. Optimized the visual effects and skill animations of existing Heroes, enhanced details of their appearance.
4. Added an upgrade system for Elemental Affinity. Players may further their adventure and explore Adenthia to obtain upgrade materials, and then upgrade Elemental Affinity in "Psychicore".
5. Added Hero Biography feature. Achieve specified conditions to unlock Hero Biography and delve into each Hero's unique experiences.
6. Added an optional Player Character image of Half-Elf origin.

[b][h2]3. Dungeon and Stage[/h2][/b]
1. Adjusted the design of dungeons for Improvement and Equipment materials. Bosses' appearance and skills are now revamped anew, while difficulty and fun have been well balanced.
2. Adjusted the design of EXP dungeon. The former Lost Fortress has been updated to Goblin Lair. Difficulty and fun have now been well balanced.
3. Optimized the gameplay of Infinite Labyrinth, iterated its stage structure, and greatly enhanced its play experience and interface interaction.
4. Added a new mode — Pillar of Trial. Each Pillar of Trial can only be challenged by deploying Heroes of a specified Element. Clear Pillar of Trial to obtain handsome rewards.
5. Added a multiplayer co-op stage on the sandbox map — Outer Chaos Rift. Call on your friends, crusade in collaboration, and relish the distinctive delight of combat strategy in a multiplayer dungeon.
6. Added Tutorial Stages. Players can complete a series of challenges using designated Heroes to familiarize themselves with pre-battle deployment, Hero selection, monster skills and other battle-related techniques.
7. Added an option to challenge NPCs. Certain NPCs can be challenged and will yield handsome rewards when you defeat them.
8. Added new scene components and monsters, rendering battles more delightful on the aspect of strategy.


[b][h1]〓Other New Content〓[/h1][/b]
1. Added Alliance system. Alliance members may collaborate with each other in completing Alliance Commissions, and claiming generous rewards in the Sparkle Tournament held every two weeks by the Three Ears Brotherhood.
2. Added a simultaneous PVP mode — Champion Arena. It is open during a specific period each day, and rewards will be settled weekly based on Rank.
3. Added new Equipment items and Artifacts, adjusted the Set Attributes and Artifact Skills of certain existing items.
4. Added Drilling Ground at Camp. Players can freely build Hero combinations in simulation battles to test their performance in battles, or invite their friends into a friendly sparring.
5. Added new Side Quests to Nytheria and South Adenthia, adjusted and optimized certain Main Quests.
6. Added a Share feature. Fulfill specified conditions to unlock this feature and share memorable pictures or videos to Facebook or TikTok.
7. Added a multilingual chat channel. On this channel, players can share information on their Equipment and Heroes with each other and thus exchange strategies of their own builds or simply show off their franchise Heroes!
8. Added an event preview feature, allowing players to take a glimpse of all important events in the current Season in advance.
9. Added 6 in-game languages: German, French, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Traditional Chinese.


[h1][b]〓Optimization and Adjustment〓[/b][/h1]
1. Adjusted Journey Level and the EXP required for upgrade. The current maximum Journey Level has been adjusted to Lv.50.
2. Optimized certain UI interaction designs, conforming to the overall style so as to enhance player experience.
3. Adjusted the beginner chapter and the one after character customization, deeply optimized the pace of the early game.
4. Optimized the visuals of battle, fixed the model overlap between giant Bosses and other objects, and adjusted the display logic of Ultimate Skill animations.
5. Optimized the reverb effects of certain indoor scenes and the sound effects of certain interfaces.
6. Optimized the visuals of certain scenes.
7. Adjusted the categories, names, introductions and quick acquisition of certain items.
8. Optimized the form of interaction and quest logic of certain events.

notes.title: CBT2 - Update Preview - Letter from the Development Team
notes.content:
Greetings, Travelers! We're delighted to be welcoming you back again! We cordially invite you to be the first to experience our game once again!

We shared an unforgettable adventure together in Adenthia just four months ago. The heroic deeds of our Travelers have spread far and wide throughout Adenthia's denizens, and the development team alike! With this latest version, many of your suggestions and criticisms have been taken on board and we've made changes and improvements. Thanks to your help, we are making a better world, so once more we extend to you our heartfelt thanks!

Over these past four months, the development team has been blazing away, aiming to make Dragonheir even more unique, and Adenthia has changed dramatically along with it. We're aware these might be disruptive, so we wanted to share these changes and adjustments with you ahead of time.

[h3][b]1. Heroes and Combat[/b][/h3]
We've added 50 brand new heroes, but not all of them will feature in CBT2 for now. As of CBT2, we have over 110 heroes, hopefully offering our Travelers even greater freedom of choice. For the time being, our CBT2 version hero bases include: Summon, Dauntless, Rally, Wild, Poison, and Frost. "Burn" and "Electric Shock" heroes will be gradually introduced in later Seasons, so you'll not find them in CBT2.
[b]Adjustment rationale: [/b]Previously, Fire element had two bases ("Wild" and "Burn") and Lightning element as well ("Dauntless" and "Electric Shock"). Because heroes of the same element could possess two different bases, assembling teams of heroes sharing the same bases proved difficult. Thus, to make obtaining heroes with bases that synergize well together more convenient for everyone, we have condensed down the hero pool for Fire and Lightning heroes. But don't fret! The heroes cut for now will return in OBT or later Seasons.
We have also buffed some rare and epic heroes, and there are also heroes with versatile bases capable of both supporting and defensive roles. Travelers should have no trouble building a complete combat-ready team able to handle most situations!

In CBT2 Adenthia, Elemental Affinity changes radically with the influence of plane rotation: Affinities between Ice and Poison, Fire and Radiance, Necrosis and Lightning are higher than ever before! Teaming up heroes of the paired elements will lead to welcome surprises on the battlefield.
[b]Adjustment rationale:[/b] We're always striving to offer you fulfilling strategy options and a wide variety of builds. We're keen on offering you fresh experiences with each Beta, so CBT2 will feature brand new Elemental Affinity effects. Notably, the rules of Elemental Affinity will change with each new Season. It's our hope that the regular rotation of Elemental Affinities will create a richer experience for everyone, as well as justify the value of each hero.

Every hero's design has been perfected, adding their population, class, and alignment, providing them with full background stories. Should they become companions, they'll engage in chatter with you at Camp and in the sandbox, with some heroes expressing their thoughts on the journey so far (thanks to the players who made this recommendation in the last Beta).
[b]Adjustment rationale: [/b]We want the hero companions that players engage to be genuine, living denizens of Adenthia, each with their own unique histories. To give Travelers a better grasp of companions' stories and to understand the customs of Adenthia through them, we've added the aforementioned content with the intention of offering a more immersive experience.

We've added a new hero attribute called "Enlightenment". It provides a new dimension to hero development by adding bonuses to non-critical damage and to some Healing/Shield effects.
[b]Adjustment rationale: [/b]This is aimed for achieving the pursuit of hero attributes a more fruitful one, whilst also offering players varied attributes on different heroes. No more bland focus on Attack and Crit! By adding "Enlightenment", we hope to offer players new focus on hero development and a more fruitful, rewarding development experience overall.

[h3][b]2. Dungeons and gameplay[/b][/h3]
We've revamped and iterated the EXP Dungeon, something that will significantly improve Travelers' battles against Goblins! After CBT2 concludes, the EXP Dungeon won't be a Tower Defense anymore, instead being a Horde mode featuring continuously refreshing waves of monsters.
[b]Adjustment rationale:[/b] Tower Defense is classic, fun-filled gameplay, characterized by strong strategy and playability. However, considering that EXP Dungeons need to be farmed a great many times, Tower Defense gameplay would become incredibly tedious. Plus, the need for manual play and concentration would be a huge source of stress in the long term. For this reason, we've changed the EXP Dungeon gameplay into one that requires less manual effort and is easily automated.
That's not to say Tower Defense is vanishing! You'll find Tower Defense all over the place in every corner of the sandbox, in stronghold conflicts and all kinds of places Travelers won't expect! When facing these stages, adventurers must be prepared! Carefully and effectively deploy before battle, use precise actions and rational team composition to tackle every challenge.

We have updated and upgraded most of the Elemental Ascension Dungeons and Equipment Dungeons. Everything in the Dungeons, from the Boss appearance to the gameplay mechanics, has been comprehensively overhauled. We hope the upgraded audio-visual effects and gameplay mechanics will breathe new life into your Dungeons! Since Elemental Dungeons are equipped with mechanics that buff and resist one element, Travelers will need to be diligent! Ensure you develop diverse teams ready to handle stages of different elements.
[b]Adjustment rationale: [/b]We want Dragonheir to offer a richly rewarding environment for trial and error that encourages Travelers to place emphasis on horizontal character development, focusing on the characteristics of hero skills, Elemental Affinities, and bases.
Changes to the Elemental Ascension Dungeons are intended to improve the current Dungeon experience. They'll also help prepare for richer gameplay and test environments to come in future!
Furthermore, adjustments to Equipment Dungeons and Rune Dungeons, as well as tweaks to Dungeon Boss skill mechanics, are in place to ensure all our Travelers understand: Each Dragonheir hero has their own unique value against different opponents. The fun of synergizing skills, Elemental Affinities and bases is what we truly aim to offer to all Travelers. Adventure and Strategy are Dragonheir's only tags. In the upcoming CBT2 Season, there is neither a sole answer to strength or weakness, nor will there be for each upcoming Season.
All of us on the development team have been extremely hands on, playing Dragonheir ourselves and testing whether our design is delivering the fun we expect it to. I'll take this chance to drop a sneaky hint! There are a few epic heroes (not legendary!) that are key to overcoming tough nuts like the Blood Prince and Deadly Harpy! As for who, you can find out for yourself, and tell us all about it, in CBT2!

[h3][b]3. Rewards & Seasons[/b][/h3]
We've added our new Season gameplay to CBT2, the rules for which will be posted separately in official communities.
Compared with CBT1's 30-day duration, this Season will last approximately three months. Accordingly, the pace of in-game reward distribution will also be [b]drastically altered:[/b]
[b]The probability of summoning legendary heroes with Heliolite Dice (Advanced Hero Summoning item) will be increased to 3%. Additionally, a legendary hero will be guaranteed in 35 draws. As a result, Heliolite Dice will become more valuable, and thus much rarer.[/b]
Heliolite Dice offered by Main Quests and the Book of Adventure will be markedly reduced. Only a small quantity will be available from Main Quests. However, Travelers can obtain a wealth of Wyrmarrow from various quests and dailies! Wyrmarrow can be used to purchase Heliolite Dice in the Shop.
Once the Season concludes, you will receive a veritable bounty of rewards in accordance with your performance. All those goodies will make next Season even more enjoyable!
The quantity of Starlight Dice (Basic Hero Summoning item) available has been significantly increased. Through using Starlight Dice to summon many epic heroes, Travelers will be well-positioned to handle most Dungeons.
We have [b]removed the Day-7 and Day-14[/b] legendary hero login rewards. Instead, Travelers will now receive epic heroes on Day 3.
[b]To ensure a better experience for our CBT2 players[/b], we will issue these website pre-registration rewards in advance: Gold, Dice, legendary heroes, etc. can be obtained by fulfilling certain criteria.
[b]Adjustment rationale:[/b]
CBT2 is a Season beta whose data will not be erased. All heroes acquired will be permanently retained. Compared to the CBT1 impermanent test, we've cut down on the rewards a little to ensure greater longevity and enjoyment of the game.
Of course, we hope that players will take full advantage of the longer three-month test duration to really sink your teeth into the build experience! We don't want login rewards to influence players' choices (during the CBT1 test, almost all players mainly developed the rewarded legendary heroes). Rather, we want players to enjoy varied, creative team composition strategies.
In replacing many rewards with the common Wyrmarrow currency, we hope to give Travelers more freedom of choice — They can choose whether to use them to purchase Skill Scrolls and enhance existing heroes or exchange them for summoning items to acquire more heroes.
We've significantly increased the quantity of Starlight Dice. With this, we hope you'll acquire more epic heroes and strive for more complete, versatile elemental builds and team compositions to provide an engaging, fruitful experience. (When compared to CBT1, in which many teams were heavily dependent on legendary heroes, making the experience threshold too high).

[b]In addition to the aforementioned content, we've added a host of other features:[/b]
We have reset and optimized the game's opening chapters: The overall Chaos Universum experience and the staging of subsequent chapters: The storyline and gameplay in the Forest and Plains regions have been totally overhauled.
We've also added plenty of new gameplay features: Added 2 NPC-related systems (Challenge and Relationship), new team PVE mode (two Travelers fight alongside each other), new time-limited real-time PVP mode, friendly sparring, Alliance, Alliance war, Seasons, and more! Stay tuned to community news for more details!
Travelers, we look forward to joining you in Adenthia once again for CBT2!

notes.title: Great news for Apple Mac players!
notes.content:
As a cross-platform game, Dragonheir is committed to providing high-quality gaming experiences for players across different devices. Dragonheir: Silent Gods will launch on Mac, Windows, iPhone and Android at [b]global launch in H2 2023[/b]. 
The development team has created keyboard and mouse-based control schemes for desktop versions of the game to provide players with precise and customizable controls based on their preferred playstyle. Available on the incredible Apple silicon Mac lineup, Dragonheir: Silent Gods is native on Mac and takes full advantage of Metal — software that powers hardware-accelerated graphics on Apple platforms — resulting in smooth and responsive gameplay with high frame rates and stunning visuals. Leveraging technology, such as Metal FX Upscaling, Variable Refresh Rate, and Spatial Audio, players will experience enhanced graphics and a more immersive audio experience.

notes.title: Closed Beta Test II - Basic Info & FAQ
notes.content:
[h1][b]Basic Information[/b][/h1]
[h2][b][Test Duration][/b][/h2]
This test will be available from 5/24/2023 02:00 AM (UTC+0) for a long period of time with servers open.
*New user registration will be stopped depending on the test progress. Please check the announcement in the community for the most up-to-date information.

[h2][b][Test Regions][/b][/h2]
The test is available in the following countries and regions: 
Australia, Canada, France, Germany,  Indonesia, Japan, Korea, Malaysia, Philippines, Taiwan, Thailand, Ukraine, the United States, and the United Kingdom. 

[h2][b][Platform and Device Requirments][/b][/h2]
This test supports PC and Android platforms.

[b][h3]PC system minimum requirements[/h3][/b]
-Operating system: 64bits-windows7 and above. 
-Processor: intel core I3 or equivalent processor 
-Memory: 4G - RAM
-Graphics card: NV GeForce 8600 GT or higher, ATI Radeon HD2600XT
-Disk space: 10G

[b][h3]Android minimum requirements[/h3][/b]
-Processor: Qualcomm Snapdragon 710/480 and above SOC
-Operating system: Android 5.0 and above
-Space: 6GB RAM and above

If you encounter any device issues, please contact us at any time.

[h2][b][User Data & Purchases][/b][/h2]
This test will open the Top-up feature, and user data of CBT2 will NOT be wiped.
Your data, including your purchases, will be saved and carried over to the global release according to the Season reset rules.
*Season reset rules: High-value resources purchased or acquired by players, including Heroes, Artifacts, and Skill Scrolls, will NOT be reset; Stamina acquired in the current Season and resources transmuted from Stamina, such as Hero Upgrade Materials, Improvement Materials and Equipment, will all be reset and totaled up. Players will receive a boatload of goodies according to the totaled-up result.
For more Season system details, please check:[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2203070/view/3685678263664050649]https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2203070/view/3685678263664050649[/url]

[h2][b][How to Download and Play][/b][/h2]
Players in select test regions can participate in this test. 
Players on PC and Android from the test regions who pre-registered by 12:00 AM on 5/21 (UTC+0) will receive an invitation email with a download link and a special gift code at 03:00 AM on 5/24/2023 (UTC+0). 
*The gift code will expire at 02:00 AM (UTC+0) on 5/27/2023. We encourage you to download and redeem it in the game as soon as possible.

The game will be available on the Google Play Store in the test regions, and we will also announce download links for PC and Android on Discord at 04:00 AM on 5/24 (UTC+0). 
*Players are able to download the game and register by clicking on randomly placed advertising in select regions.


[h1][b]FAQ[/b][/h1]
[h2][b][Game & Account][/b][/h2]
[h3][b]When will Dragonheir be available to all regions?[/b][/h3]
The Closed beta test II of Dragonheir is planned to be tested first in some regions, and players from other regions can play the game after the Global launch. Please follow our official announcement for follow-up information.

[h3][b]When can I find the D&D collaboration content in the game?[/b][/h3]
Popular characters from the world of Dungeons & Dragons, such as Drizzt Do’Urden, will be making their way onto the Multiversal Plane in Dragonheir: Silent Gods in the coming two years as Dragonheir: Silent Gods' global launch(S1) in the second half of 2023.

[h3][b]Which languages are supported in this test?[/b][/h3]
This test supports English, German, French, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese.

[h3][b]Will my data be deleted when the test ends?[/b][/h3]
The servers will open permanently. Your user data will NOT be deleted.
Your data, including your purchases, will be saved and carried over to the global release according to the Season reset rules.
For more Season system details, please check:[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2203070/view/3685678263664050649]https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2203070/view/3685678263664050649[/url]

[h3][b]Will my account data be shared across different platforms?[/b][/h3]
Yes, your account data can be shared across PC and Android platforms, as well as iOS in the future.
One account can only be logged in on one device at a time. You can not log in to the same account on multiple platforms simultaneously.

[h3][b]Can I delete my account and start over?[/b][/h3]
Currently, account reset is unavailable. If you wish to create a new role, you can either create a new visitor role by switching to a new device or create a new account by using a new third-party account such as Google or Facebook.

[h3][b]If I encounter an in-game problem, such as a bug, how should I seek help?[/b][/h3]
Mobile players can seek support directly in-game. (You can find the entrance in the upper right corner of the main interface of the game, click Expand - Settings, and the customer service is in the upper right corner of the interface.)
For PC players, we are sorry that currently, we can not support in-game customer service. You can reach out to us through Discord, email, or Facebook DM.
Discord: Please create a ticket on the #need-help channel.
E-mail:[url= dragonheir-support@nvsgames.com] dragonheir-support@nvsgames.com[/url]
Facebook Fan Page: [url=https://www.facebook.com/DragonheirGame/]https://www.facebook.com/DragonheirGame/[/url]

[h2][b][Purchase][/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Do I have to pay to play the game?[/b][/h3]
No, Dragonheir is a free-to-play game. You can download the game for free.
This test will open the Top-up feature, and you can purchase items you need in the item shop.

[h3][b]Will my purchase data be deleted?[/b][/h3]
No. High-value resources purchased or acquired by players, including Heroes, Artifacts, and Skill Scrolls, will NOT be reset; Stamina acquired in the current Season and resources transmuted from Stamina, such as Hero Upgrade Materials, Improvement Materials and Equipment, will all be reset and totaled up. Players will receive a boatload of goodies according to the totaled-up result. 
For more Season system details, please check:[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2203070/view/3685678263664050649]https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2203070/view/3685678263664050649[/url]

[h3][b]Will my purchase data be shared across different platforms? Can I top-up on PC if I play on mobile?[/b][/h3]
Yes, your purchase data will be shared across all platforms. Android players can top-up on the PC store.

[h3][b]Is there any difference between purchasing items in-game on mobile and from the PC store?[/b][/h3]
No, both platforms sell the same products at the same prices.

notes.title: Preview of New Features: Enjoy the Multiverse Through Passing "Seasons"!
notes.content:
The rallying horns of Adenthia are sounding, the DragonHeir CBT2 is about to begin!
Since CBT1 ended, we've developed lots of new content! We'd like to now introduce you to one of this update's biggest highlights: Seasons!

[b]Question 1: What are Seasons?[/b]
[b]Answer 1[/b]: Much like when you're running around adventuring, we want to keep your experiences in the "Campaign" of Adenthia fresh and varied, including ever-changing plots and environments. Seasons are episodic experiences, each one offering players something complete and fresh.

A Season will initially run for 12-14 weeks. Other Seasons will see inclusions of the following:
- New narrative content: New maps, new stories, new bosses, and all-new heroes and new populations!
- New collaborations: We'll gradually be introducing licensed DND crossovers with Drizzt, Elminster and other heroes who are visiting Adenthia.
- Combat companions: Players from other planes can join your adventure of the new Season and aid you in your crusade against an ancient boss or compete for glory in the arena!
- Reroll: A herculean strongman with all points in Strength can become a wizened Scholar with significant Intelligence!
- Elemental Affinity Rotation: Affinities among elements change between Seasons. For example, in S0, Ice and Poison may have an affinity, but come S1, Ice might instead have an affinity with Necrosis. It will impact combat strategy dramatically!
- Resetting Game Resources: The reset is to ensure gameplay doesn't become stale. Once a Season is closed and totaled up, everyone will receive a boatload of goodies! (That includes limited and exclusive rewards). See Question 2 for more information.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/14269b151bbd406a64aa5b8099f49fbd7f6ccffe.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/bc7cff8d1d64947015f983a2bb279b878e2aa905.jpg[/img]

[b]Question 2: Which resources will be reset each Season?[/b]
[b]Answer 2[/b]: We've actually been discussing this for a long while. At the core of "Reset" is the desire to prevent players getting bored, giving them the fun of rerolling, and trying out new strategies so the late game doesn't become tedious.

[b]Reset rules of S0 are as follows:[/b]

[b]Permanently Saved[/b]
High-value resources purchased or acquired by players, including Heroes, Artifacts, and Skill Scrolls, will not be reset.
[b]Seasonally Reset[/b]
Stamina acquired in the current Season and resources transmuted from Stamina, such as Hero Upgrade Materials, Improvement Materials and Equipment, will all be reset.

Of course, whilst equipment will be reset, there will be new dungeons to undertake and strategies to employ for each new Season, ensuring acquiring those materials and equipment won't be as troublesome as in some other similar games. (I'm sure we're all fed up of farming instances over and over only to end up with worthless equipment drops!)
If you're curious, more detailed reset rules will be found in-game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/509d0bc3ab9f776595e6f6a85af3f746f6d19e0c.png[/img]

[b]Question 3: Why do Seasons? That seems like a risky decision.[/b]
[b]Answer 3[/b]: It certainly is risky! But having spent thousands of hours with Team RPGs, the development team picked out a few issues:
- Alongside raising stats over a lengthy period, players wanted to try different team builds, but found it wasn't affordable. Challenging stages became increasingly difficult, and they found themselves expending waaaaaaaaay too much effort to complete a stage.
- The longer the game is live, the greater the chasm between the old players and new players becomes, and so ever fewer players can stay and play together.
- The dungeons and bosses never change, the teams barely change, and players end up farming for equipment, an experience which is grindy and tedious.
So, that's why we aimed to solve this problem by making the bold but difficult decision to implement Seasons.
- New Seasons mean all-new content, brand new goals, and fun gameplay.
- Resetting stat values lowers leveling costs and lets players try out a wider range of team builds. Plus, for players who need time away from the game, coming back after a break isn't the end of the world! When a new Season begins, everyone is back in the same starting position.
- Season Settlement is a nice justification to shower players with rewards from time to time!
But equally, we recognize that Season is a brand-new design, so we are expecting plenty of problems and bugs. That's why we need to run this Pilot Season (S0) to perfect it.

[b]Question 4: CBT2 is the Pilot Season, S0. How will the pilot differ from the official ones?[/b]
[b]Answer 4[/b]: CBT2 (S0) is essentially a preview version of the official Season (S1). Nothing will be deleted, you can make purchases and enjoy a taste of S1 content in advance.
The primary aim is to verify Season gameplay on a small scale. Therefore, S0 will only be open for a limited time (limited access as well) and only in some countries/regions.
S0 will have the same settlement process as the official Season. Rewards obtained in S0, including heroes and artifacts, will also be kept until the official Season is released. S0 testers will also be rewarded with exclusive commemorative rewards!
As for what's to come in S1, we're going to leave you hanging and build the suspense!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43178138/6ab152e0e8f8842ab0ce05b6ddfb223a664224c8.jpg[/img]
Note: Season rules will be changed and adjusted in accordance with test feedback.

notes.title: A New Year Letter
notes.content:
Greetings Adventurers, and happy new year!

The current test has already witnessed the passing of 24 days and nights, and is now coming to an end along with the year 2022. How time flies! We are here to extend our sincere gratitude towards your dedicated exploration in Adenthia and the constructive feedback, which is highly valuable to us. So far, we have determined the direction of development and iteration for the next version, and thus started a new period of design and adjustment.

We are thrilled to respond to a widely concerned question here: Data and account information will NOT be deleted in the next test! Meanwhile, besides the discovery of Adenthia, the order of the Dragonheir universe will gradually reveal itself, under which the world will manifest its true form. You will surely be confronted with more diverse battles, a variety of foes, and a bigger crisis. By providing us with your account information in the current test, Adventurers participating in the next test will be rewarded with an ample booster of Dragon Crystal Dice, Master Scrolls, and even more!

Moreover, about 50 new heroes will arrive in the Dragonheir universe in the next version, along with an increased number of powerful Bosses and thrilling game modes. A Guild system and related gameplay mechanics will be added, in which Adventurers should unite as one and challenge the legendary World Boss collaboratively. Gameplay and quests that are not fully developed will also be completed in the next version. More languages will become available to ensure an immersive journey in Adenthia for more Adventurers around the globe.

We would like to thank you again for your support, and your valuable suggestions sent to us via our support team, Discord channel, and other social media. Happy new year, dear Adventurers. We are looking forward to the next time we meet!

notes.title: 💌 A THANK YOU LETTER FROM THE DEV TEAM
notes.content:
Hi, adventurers, happy Thanksgiving！ 

We are excited to see you again soon! We would like to invite you to experience our new adventure.

Three months ago, your heroic deeds spread among the Adenthia and the development team. A lot of your feedback and suggestions have been incorporated into our latest release - you help us make the Dragonheir world a better place, thanks again everyone.

In this new journey, the number of our heroes has increased to 85+, with several times more team builds than the last test, burning, summoning, frost, dauntless, inspiration, and many other mysterious and interesting builds, hope you will like it!
In this new journey, we have added two new sandbox worlds: the Chaos Universum where the Positive Plane and Negative Plane fight and erode each other, and the plain where the orcs and humans are constantly fighting. There will be many new friends meeting you in the game plot.

Based on your feedback, we have also greatly simplified our development system, hero level breakthrough no longer needs to "eat" other heroes.  The hero partner in the novice stage can also accompany everyone in the adventure process at all times.

At the same time, we have also added a lot of new ways to play in the camp. We can collect ore in the sandbox and return to the camp to forge equipment; we can use the horn to communicate with heroes from other worlds in the camp. This may be the best news for adventurers who like infrastructure!
In addition, we have more gameplay and content waiting for everyone to experience, and the Adenthia always welcome wise adventurers.

Once again, a big thank you to everyone who took the time to give us suggestions and feedback through our support team, discord channel, and other communities. Looking forward to seeing you again in the upcoming test!

[b]Dragonheir: Silent Gods Dev Team [/b]
